## Cohort size and cell lines available per data source

When `data/HMA_BCL2_cohort_assignments.rds` exists (created by knitting **Cell_Line_Assignment_Verification.Rmd** first), Table 1 uses the cleaned, expanded cohort from that verification report. Otherwise it uses fallback lineage assignment from DepMap metadata.

**Cohort** = DepMap cell lines with expression and lineage assignment (same set as in Figure 1). **CRISPR** = cohort cell lines with BCL2 CERES dependency data in DepMap (CERES subpanels in Figure 1); the same cohort is used, but not every cohort line has CERES data, so N (CRISPR) can be less than or equal to N (cohort). **GDSC, PRISM, CTRP** = cohort cell lines with drug sensitivity data in each platform. **Methylation** = cohort cell lines with GSE68379 (Illumina HumanMethylation450) data matched to DepMap (Figures 15–16). A cell line may appear in multiple sources.

Below: **Table 1** (cell lines per data source) is printed first, then **one combined 2×2 figure** with **BCL2** expression (top left) and **BCL2** CERES (top right), **DNMT1** expression (bottom left) and **DNMT1** CERES (bottom right) on the **same** wide lineage x-axis, strata, and fill colors as the BCL2 expression panel (DepMap). Lineage tick labels appear on **both** bottom-row panels; the top row omits x tick labels. Cell lines and `lab`/`subtype` assignments follow the **BCL2 expression** wide figure so DNMT1 panels show the same lineages in the same order with the same box colors.

```{r table-1-cell-lines-by-source, include = TRUE, cache = FALSE, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
# Table 1: Cell lines available per data source (merged; includes CRISPR so readers see it may differ from cohort)
# Colorectal lineages excluded from this table only (per prior reporting).
lineage_levels_t1 <- lineage_levels[!grepl("Colorectal", lineage_levels, fixed = TRUE)]
expr_target_t1 <- expr_target %>%
  dplyr::filter(!grepl("Colorectal", as.character(.data$lineage_group), fixed = TRUE)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(lineage_group = factor(as.character(.data$lineage_group), levels = lineage_levels_t1))
t1_cohort <- tibble(lineage_group = factor(lineage_levels_t1, levels = lineage_levels_t1)) %>%
  left_join(expr_target_t1 %>% dplyr::count(lineage_group, name = "N_cohort"), by = "lineage_group") %>%
  mutate(N_cohort = replace_na(N_cohort, 0L)) %>%
  arrange(lineage_group)

# CRISPR: cohort lines with BCL2 CERES data (same definition as CERES subpanels in Figure 1)
t1_crispr <- if (exists("crispr") && exists("target_ids") && nrow(crispr) > 0 && length(target_ids) > 0) {
  crispr %>%
    filter(grepl("^BCL2\\b", gene_name), depmap_id %in% target_ids) %>%
    left_join(expr_target %>% select(depmap_id, lineage_group), by = "depmap_id") %>%
    filter(!is.na(lineage_group)) %>%
    dplyr::count(lineage_group, name = "N_CRISPR")
} else {
  expr_target %>% distinct(lineage_group) %>% mutate(N_CRISPR = 0L) %>% select(lineage_group, N_CRISPR)
}

t1_gdsc <- if (exists("merged_aza") && nrow(merged_aza) > 0 && "lineage_group" %in% names(merged_aza)) {
  merged_aza %>% filter(!is.na(lineage_group)) %>% dplyr::count(lineage_group, name = "N_GDSC")
} else { expr_target %>% distinct(lineage_group) %>% mutate(N_GDSC = 0L) %>% select(lineage_group, N_GDSC) }
t1_prism <- if (exists("pair_df") && nrow(pair_df) > 0 && "lineage_group" %in% names(pair_df)) {
  pair_df %>% filter(!is.na(lineage_group)) %>% dplyr::count(lineage_group, name = "N_PRISM")
} else { expr_target %>% distinct(lineage_group) %>% mutate(N_PRISM = 0L) %>% select(lineage_group, N_PRISM) }
t1_ctrp <- if (exists("ctrp_long") && nrow(ctrp_long) > 0) {
  ctrp_long %>% distinct(depmap_id, lineage_group) %>% dplyr::count(lineage_group, name = "N_CTRP")
} else { expr_target %>% distinct(lineage_group) %>% mutate(N_CTRP = 0L) %>% select(lineage_group, N_CTRP) }

# Methylation (GSE68379): cohort lines with global methylation data (same match as 09_DNMTi_OnTarget_Methylation)
t1_methylation <- NULL
t1_global_meth_depmap_ids <- character(0)
meth_global_path <- if (requireNamespace("here", quietly = TRUE)) here::here("data", "GSE68379_global_methylation.csv") else file.path("data", "GSE68379_global_methylation.csv")
alt_global <- file.path("..", "data", "GSE68379_global_methylation.csv")
for (f in c(meth_global_path, alt_global)) {
  if (file.exists(f) && file.size(f) > 0 && exists("meta") && exists("expr_target")) {
    global_meth_raw <- tryCatch(readr::read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(global_meth_raw) && nrow(global_meth_raw) > 0) {
      global_meth <- global_meth_raw %>%
        filter(!is.na(global_mean_beta), global_mean_beta >= 0, global_mean_beta <= 1) %>%
        mutate(
          cell_line_clean = gsub("_AVG\\.Beta$", "", as.character(cell_line)),
          cell_line_stem = gsub("-", "", gsub("_.*$", "", cell_line_clean))
        )
      meta_stem <- meta %>% mutate(cell_line_stem = gsub("-", "", gsub("_.*$", "", cell_line)))
      global_meth_depmap <- global_meth %>%
        inner_join(meta_stem %>% select(depmap_id, cell_line_stem), by = "cell_line_stem") %>%
        distinct(depmap_id, .keep_all = TRUE)
      t1_global_meth_depmap_ids <- unique(as.character(global_meth_depmap$depmap_id))
      meth_lineage <- expr_target_t1 %>%
        select(depmap_id, lineage_group) %>%
        inner_join(global_meth_depmap %>% select(depmap_id), by = "depmap_id") %>%
        dplyr::count(lineage_group, name = "N_methylation")
      t1_methylation <- tibble(lineage_group = factor(lineage_levels_t1, levels = lineage_levels_t1)) %>%
        left_join(meth_lineage, by = "lineage_group") %>%
        mutate(N_methylation = replace_na(N_methylation, 0L))
      break
    }
  }
}
if (is.null(t1_methylation)) {
  t1_methylation <- expr_target_t1 %>% distinct(lineage_group) %>% mutate(N_methylation = 0L) %>% select(lineage_group, N_methylation)
}

t1_body <- t1_cohort %>%
  left_join(t1_crispr, by = "lineage_group") %>%
  left_join(t1_gdsc, by = "lineage_group") %>%
  left_join(t1_prism, by = "lineage_group") %>%
  left_join(t1_ctrp, by = "lineage_group") %>%
  left_join(t1_methylation, by = "lineage_group") %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("N_"), ~replace(., is.na(.), 0L)))

# Table 1: omit strata with "Unspecified" in the lineage label (all masters; full cohort unchanged for figures)
t1_body <- dplyr::filter(t1_body, !grepl("Unspecified", as.character(.data$lineage_group), fixed = TRUE))

t1_total <- t1_body %>% summarise(
  lineage_group = "Total",
  N_cohort = sum(N_cohort),
  N_CRISPR = sum(N_CRISPR, na.rm = TRUE),
  N_GDSC = sum(N_GDSC),
  N_PRISM = sum(N_PRISM),
  N_CTRP = sum(N_CTRP),
  N_methylation = sum(N_methylation, na.rm = TRUE)
)
t1_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(t1_body, t1_total) %>%
  mutate(Lineage = gsub(" \\(control\\)", "", as.character(lineage_group))) %>%
  select(Lineage, `N (cohort)` = N_cohort, `N (CRISPR)` = N_CRISPR, `N (GDSC)` = N_GDSC, `N (PRISM)` = N_PRISM, `N (CTRP)` = N_CTRP, `N (methylation)` = N_methylation)

t1_kable <- t1_df %>%
  kable(caption = "Table 1. Cell lines available per data source. Cohort = DepMap expression/lineage (Figure 1). CRISPR = cohort lines with BCL2 CERES data (CERES subpanels in Figure 1). GDSC, PRISM, CTRP = cohort lines with drug sensitivity in each platform. Methylation = cohort lines with GSE68379 (Illumina 450k) data matched to DepMap. A line may appear in multiple sources.") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("bordered", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
cat("\n\n")
print(t1_kable)
cat("\n\n")
```

```{r bcl2i-table-42, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
# Table 2: BCL2 inhibitors and DNMTi in the dataset — types, mechanisms, and N (cohort cell lines) in GDSC, PRISM, CTRP
# 4.1 BCL2 inhibitors
bcl2i_simple <- tibble::tibble(
  Compound = c("Venetoclax (ABT-199, GDC-0199)", "Navitoclax (ABT-263)", "Obatoclax", "ABT-737"),
  `Target / mechanism` = c(
    "BCL2-selective; FDA-approved (AML, CLL)",
    "BCL2 + BCL-xL; thrombocytopenia risk",
    "Pan-BH3 mimetic (MCL1, BCL2, BCL-xL)",
    "BCL2 + BCL-xL; first-in-class BH3 mimetic"
  ),
  `N (GDSC)` = NA_integer_,
  `N (PRISM)` = NA_integer_,
  `N (CTRP)` = NA_integer_
)
cohort_ids <- if (exists("target_ids")) target_ids else character(0)
# PRISM: cohort cell lines with that compound
if (exists("drug_sens") && exists("bcl2i_prism") && nrow(bcl2i_prism) > 0 && length(cohort_ids) > 0) {
  n_prism <- drug_sens %>% filter(depmap_id %in% cohort_ids, name %in% bcl2i_prism$name) %>%
    group_by(name) %>% summarise(n = n_distinct(depmap_id), .groups = "drop")
  bcl2i_simple <- bcl2i_simple %>%
    mutate(
      `N (PRISM)` = c(
        sum(n_prism$n[grepl("venetoclax|ABT-199|GDC-0199", n_prism$name, ignore.case = TRUE)], na.rm = TRUE),
        sum(n_prism$n[grepl("navitoclax|ABT-263", n_prism$name, ignore.case = TRUE)], na.rm = TRUE),
        sum(n_prism$n[grepl("obatoclax", n_prism$name, ignore.case = TRUE)], na.rm = TRUE),
        sum(n_prism$n[grepl("ABT-737", n_prism$name, ignore.case = TRUE)], na.rm = TRUE)
      )
    )
}
# GDSC: cohort cell lines with that BCL2i (from gdsc_raw if available)
if (exists("gdsc_raw") && nrow(gdsc_raw) > 0 && exists("meta") && length(cohort_ids) > 0) {
  nm <- names(gdsc_raw)
  col_drug <- nm[tolower(nm) == "drug_name"][1]; if (length(col_drug) == 0) col_drug <- "DRUG_NAME"
  col_cell <- nm[tolower(nm) == "cell_line_name"][1]; if (length(col_cell) == 0) col_cell <- "CELL_LINE_NAME"
  gdsc_drugs <- unique(gdsc_raw[[col_drug]])
  bcl2i_gdsc_names <- gdsc_drugs[grepl("venetoclax|ABT-199|GDC-0199|navitoclax|ABT-263|obatoclax|ABT-737", gdsc_drugs, ignore.case = TRUE)]
  if (length(bcl2i_gdsc_names) > 0) {
    meta_stem <- meta %>% mutate(cell_line_stem = gsub("-", "", gsub("_.*$", "", cell_line)))
    gdsc_bcl2i <- gdsc_raw %>%
      filter(.data[[col_drug]] %in% bcl2i_gdsc_names) %>%
      mutate(cell_line_stem = gsub("_.*$", "", gsub("-", "", as.character(.data[[col_cell]]))))
    gdsc_bcl2i <- gdsc_bcl2i %>%
      inner_join(meta_stem %>% select(depmap_id, cell_line_stem), by = "cell_line_stem") %>%
      filter(depmap_id %in% cohort_ids)
    if (nrow(gdsc_bcl2i) > 0) {
      n_gdsc <- gdsc_bcl2i %>%
        mutate(drug_name = as.character(.data[[col_drug]])) %>%
        group_by(drug_name) %>% summarise(n = n_distinct(depmap_id), .groups = "drop")
      bcl2i_simple <- bcl2i_simple %>%
        mutate(
          `N (GDSC)` = c(
            sum(n_gdsc$n[grepl("venetoclax|ABT-199|GDC-0199", n_gdsc$drug_name, ignore.case = TRUE)], na.rm = TRUE),
            sum(n_gdsc$n[grepl("navitoclax|ABT-263", n_gdsc$drug_name, ignore.case = TRUE)], na.rm = TRUE),
            sum(n_gdsc$n[grepl("obatoclax", n_gdsc$drug_name, ignore.case = TRUE)], na.rm = TRUE),
            sum(n_gdsc$n[grepl("ABT-737", n_gdsc$drug_name, ignore.case = TRUE)], na.rm = TRUE)
          )
        )
    }
  }
}
# CTRP: cohort cell lines with any BCL2 inhibitor (CTRP is summarized by drug_class)
if (exists("ctrp_long") && nrow(ctrp_long) > 0 && length(cohort_ids) > 0) {
  n_ctrp_bcl2i <- ctrp_long %>%
    filter(drug_class == "BCL2 inhibitor", depmap_id %in% cohort_ids) %>%
    distinct(depmap_id) %>% nrow()
  bcl2i_simple <- bcl2i_simple %>% mutate(`N (CTRP)` = n_ctrp_bcl2i)
}
# 4.2 DNMTi (hypomethylating agents / HMA): DNMT1 inhibitors in the dataset
dnmti_simple <- tibble::tibble(
  Compound = c("Decitabine (5-aza-2'-deoxycytidine)", "Azacitidine (5-azacytidine)"),
  `Target / mechanism` = c(
    "DNMT1 inhibitor; cytidine analog (DNA incorporation)",
    "DNMT1 inhibitor; cytidine analog (RNA/DNA incorporation)"
  ),
  `N (GDSC)` = NA_integer_,
  `N (PRISM)` = NA_integer_,
  `N (CTRP)` = NA_integer_
)
cohort_ids_tbl <- if (exists("target_ids")) target_ids else character(0)
if (exists("drug_sens") && nrow(drug_sens) > 0 && length(cohort_ids_tbl) > 0) {
  aza_names <- unique(drug_sens$name)[grepl("azacitidine|decitabine|5-aza|dacogen", unique(drug_sens$name), ignore.case = TRUE)]
  if (length(aza_names) > 0) {
    n_prism_aza <- drug_sens %>% filter(depmap_id %in% cohort_ids_tbl, name %in% aza_names) %>%
      group_by(name) %>% summarise(n = n_distinct(depmap_id), .groups = "drop")
    dnmti_simple <- dnmti_simple %>%
      mutate(
        `N (PRISM)` = c(
          sum(n_prism_aza$n[grepl("decitabine|dacogen|5-aza-2", n_prism_aza$name, ignore.case = TRUE)], na.rm = TRUE),
          sum(n_prism_aza$n[grepl("azacitidine|5-azacytidine|5-aza[^2]|vidaza", n_prism_aza$name, ignore.case = TRUE)], na.rm = TRUE)
        )
      )
  }
}
if (exists("gdsc_raw") && nrow(gdsc_raw) > 0 && length(cohort_ids_tbl) > 0 && exists("meta")) {
  nm <- names(gdsc_raw)
  col_drug <- nm[tolower(nm) == "drug_name"][1]; if (length(col_drug) == 0) col_drug <- "DRUG_NAME"
  col_cell <- nm[tolower(nm) == "cell_line_name"][1]; if (length(col_cell) == 0) col_cell <- "CELL_LINE_NAME"
  gdsc_drugs <- unique(gdsc_raw[[col_drug]])
  aza_gdsc <- gdsc_drugs[grepl("azacitidine|decitabine|5-aza|dacogen|vidaza", gdsc_drugs, ignore.case = TRUE)]
  if (length(aza_gdsc) > 0) {
    meta_stem <- meta %>% mutate(cell_line_stem = gsub("-", "", gsub("_.*$", "", cell_line)))
    gdsc_aza <- gdsc_raw %>% filter(.data[[col_drug]] %in% aza_gdsc) %>%
      mutate(cell_line_stem = gsub("_.*$", "", gsub("-", "", as.character(.data[[col_cell]]))))
    gdsc_aza <- gdsc_aza %>% inner_join(meta_stem %>% select(depmap_id, cell_line_stem), by = "cell_line_stem") %>%
      filter(depmap_id %in% cohort_ids_tbl)
    if (nrow(gdsc_aza) > 0) {
      n_gdsc_aza <- gdsc_aza %>% mutate(drug_name = as.character(.data[[col_drug]])) %>%
        group_by(drug_name) %>% summarise(n = n_distinct(depmap_id), .groups = "drop")
      dnmti_simple <- dnmti_simple %>%
        mutate(
          `N (GDSC)` = c(
            sum(n_gdsc_aza$n[grepl("decitabine|dacogen|5-aza-2", n_gdsc_aza$drug_name, ignore.case = TRUE)], na.rm = TRUE),
            sum(n_gdsc_aza$n[grepl("azacitidine|5-azacytidine|vidaza", n_gdsc_aza$drug_name, ignore.case = TRUE)], na.rm = TRUE)
          )
        )
    }
  }
}
if (exists("ctrp_long") && nrow(ctrp_long) > 0 && length(cohort_ids_tbl) > 0) {
  n_ctrp_aza <- ctrp_long %>%
    filter(drug_class == "HMA", depmap_id %in% cohort_ids_tbl) %>%
    distinct(depmap_id) %>% nrow()
  if (n_ctrp_aza > 0) dnmti_simple <- dnmti_simple %>% mutate(`N (CTRP)` = n_ctrp_aza)
}

            sum(n_gdsc_h2$n[grepl("tucatinib", n_gdsc_h2$drug_name, ignore.case = TRUE)], na.rm = TRUE),
            sum(n_gdsc_h2$n[grepl("afatinib", n_gdsc_h2$drug_name, ignore.case = TRUE)], na.rm = TRUE),
            sum(n_gdsc_h2$n[grepl("neratinib", n_gdsc_h2$drug_name, ignore.case = TRUE)], na.rm = TRUE),
            sum(n_gdsc_h2$n[grepl("pyrotinib", n_gdsc_h2$drug_name, ignore.case = TRUE)], na.rm = TRUE),
            sum(n_gdsc_h2$n[grepl("poziotinib", n_gdsc_h2$drug_name, ignore.case = TRUE)], na.rm = TRUE),
            sum(n_gdsc_h2$n[grepl("sapitinib", n_gdsc_h2$drug_name, ignore.case = TRUE)], na.rm = TRUE)
          )
        )
    }
  }
}
# NA counts displayed as 0; drop compounds with no cohort coverage in any platform (0 / NA / 0 → 0,0,0 → omit)
.table2_coalesce_drop_all_zero <- function(df) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0L) return(df)
  df %>%
    mutate(
      `N (GDSC)` = as.integer(dplyr::coalesce(`N (GDSC)`, 0L)),
      `N (PRISM)` = as.integer(dplyr::coalesce(`N (PRISM)`, 0L)),
      `N (CTRP)` = as.integer(dplyr::coalesce(`N (CTRP)`, 0L))
    ) %>%
    filter(`N (GDSC)` > 0L | `N (PRISM)` > 0L | `N (CTRP)` > 0L)
}
bcl2i_simple <- .table2_coalesce_drop_all_zero(bcl2i_simple)
dnmti_simple <- .table2_coalesce_drop_all_zero(dnmti_simple)
ezh2i_simple <- .table2_coalesce_drop_all_zero(ezh2i_simple)
her2i_simple <- .table2_coalesce_drop_all_zero(her2i_simple)
t2_kable <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  bcl2i_simple %>% mutate(Section = "4.1 BCL2 inhibitors"),
  dnmti_simple %>% mutate(Section = "4.2 DNMTi (HMA)"),
  ezh2i_simple %>% mutate(Section = "4.3 EZH2 inhibitors"),
  her2i_simple %>% mutate(Section = "4.4 HER2-directed (small molecules)")
) %>%
  select(Section, Compound, `Target / mechanism`, `N (GDSC)`, `N (PRISM)`, `N (CTRP)`) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Table 2 (Supp table 2). B-cell lymphoma 2 inhibitors (BCL2i; 4.1), DNA methyltransferase inhibitors (DNMTi; 4.2), enhancer of zeste homolog 2 inhibitors (EZH2i; 4.3), and HER2-directed small molecules (4.4) in the dataset: compound, target/mechanism, and number of cohort cell lines tested in Genomics of Drug Sensitivity in Cancer (GDSC), Profiling Relative Inhibition Simultaneously in Mixtures (PRISM), and Cancer Therapeutics Response Portal (CTRP). Missing platform counts are shown as 0. Compounds with zero cell lines in all three sources are omitted (e.g. agents not in the PRISM subset and absent from GDSC for this cohort). DNMTi = hypomethylating agents (e.g. decitabine, azacitidine). EZH2i = EZH2 (PRC2) inhibitors (e.g. tazemetostat). CTRP extracts in this pipeline include HMA and BCL2i only, so N (CTRP) for HER2i is 0. HER2 agents align with the strict GDSC list used for ERBB2 concordance (lapatinib, tucatinib, afatinib, neratinib, pyrotinib, poziotinib, sapitinib).") %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("bordered", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
if (!exists("hma_bcl2_tnbc_lymph_master") || !isTRUE(hma_bcl2_tnbc_lymph_master)) {
  print(t2_kable)
}

### BCL2 expression and BH3-related mitochondrial proteins composition is similar in AML and some stem-like solid tumor lineages

In Figure 1, **each point is one cell line**; the x-axis shows lineage with N per group (e.g. ExPulm-SCNEC N=5). The box summarizes the distribution; overlaid points show the actual sample size. **Red dots** = NEPC (ExPulm-SCNEC from prostate); other points are gray. The same red/gray scheme is used for ExPulm-SCNEC on **expression** panels (BCL2 and DNMT1 RNA). **Wide CERES** panels include only cell lines with non-missing dependency scores (same x-axis order as expression; lines without CERES are omitted from those two panels). CERES tick **N** counts plotted scores per stratum (may differ from expression **N**).

# Figure 1/2 composites: axis titles, tick labels, and rotated lineage names (ggplot pt size; +4 pt vs prior default)
.f1_fig12_text_pt <- 24
.f1_lineage_axis_x <- function(angle) ggplot2::element_text(angle = angle, hjust = 1, size = .f1_fig12_text_pt)
.f1_fig12_axis_theme <- function(angle_x = 45) {
  ggplot2::theme(
    text = ggplot2::element_text(size = .f1_fig12_text_pt),
    axis.text.x = .f1_lineage_axis_x(angle_x),
    axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = .f1_fig12_text_pt),
    axis.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = .f1_fig12_text_pt),
    plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = .f1_fig12_text_pt),
    legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = .f1_fig12_text_pt),
    strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = .f1_fig12_text_pt)
  )
}
# annotate(..., size) uses mm; slightly larger than strict pt→mm so bracket p-values read like axis text.
.f1_fig12_bracket_label_mm <- .f1_fig12_text_pt * (25.4 / 72.27) * 1.28
# Top plot.margin (pt) when ggsignif-style brackets run; keep patchwork row themes in sync with two-tier value.
.f1_fig12_bracket_margin_top_2tier <- 120L
.f1_fig12_bracket_margin_top_1tier <- 58L
# Wide-axis: shorten metastatic (m*) and pooled localized (cl*) tick labels (e.g. "Colorectal — localized" -> "clColorectal", "mBreast").
.f1_axis_tok_tissue <- function(w) {
  w <- trimws(as.character(w))
  if (!nzchar(w)) {
    return("")
  }
  if (grepl("^[A-Z0-9 /-]+$", w) && nchar(w) <= 12L) {
    return(w)
  }
  paste0(toupper(substr(w, 1L, 1L)), tolower(substring(w, 2L)))
}
.f1_axis_short_met_label <- function(x) {
  if (length(x) < 1L) {
    return(x)
  }
  vapply(x, function(s0) {
    s <- as.character(s0)
    if (!nzchar(s)) {
      return(s0)
    }
    suf <- ""
    base <- s
    if (grepl(" N=", s, fixed = TRUE)) {
      parts <- strsplit(s, " N=", fixed = TRUE)[[1L]]
      base <- parts[[1L]]
      suf <- paste0(" N=", paste(parts[-1L], collapse = " N="))
    }
    out <- if (grepl(" — metastatic$", base)) {
      tissue <- sub(" — metastatic$", "", base)
      paste0("m", .f1_axis_tok_tissue(tissue))
    } else if (grepl("^Metastatic\\s+", base, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
      rest <- trimws(sub("^Metastatic\\s+", "", base, ignore.case = TRUE))
      paste0("m", .f1_axis_tok_tissue(rest))
    } else if (grepl(" — localized$", base)) {
      tissue <- sub(" — localized$", "", base)
      paste0("cl", .f1_axis_tok_tissue(tissue))
    } else if (grepl("^Localized\\s+", base, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
      rest <- trimws(sub("^Localized\\s+", "", base, ignore.case = TRUE))
      paste0("cl", .f1_axis_tok_tissue(rest))
    } else {
      base
    }
    paste0(out, suf)
  }, character(1L), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}
# Wide Figure 1 CERES/DNMT1 CERES: tick labels use counts of plotted (finite) dependency rows per `lab`; NEPC with N=0 is blank (no false cohort N).
.f1_ceres_wide_x_labeller <- function(n_plotted_by_lab) {
  function(x) {
    vapply(x, function(s0) {
      s <- as.character(s0)
      if (!nzchar(s)) {
        return("")
      }
      parts <- strsplit(s, " N=", fixed = TRUE)[[1L]]
      base <- parts[[1L]]
      nc <- unname(n_plotted_by_lab[s])
      if (length(nc) != 1L || is.na(nc)) {
        nc <- 0L
      }
      nc <- as.integer(nc)
      if (nc == 0L && grepl("^NEPC\\b", base)) {
        return("")
      }
      s_new <- paste0(base, " N=", nc)
      .f1_axis_short_met_label(s_new)
    }, character(1L), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
  }
}
# #region agent log
.agent_dbg_ndjson <- function(runId, hypothesisId, location, message, data = list()) {
  if (!requireNamespace("jsonlite", quietly = TRUE)) {
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  payload <- list(
    sessionId = "75d08b",
    runId = runId,
    hypothesisId = hypothesisId,
    location = location,
    message = message,
    data = data,
    timestamp = as.integer(as.numeric(Sys.time()) * 1000)
  )
  tryCatch(
    cat(jsonlite::toJSON(payload, auto_unbox = TRUE, null = "null"), "\n", sep = "", file = "/Users/Alex/R/.cursor/debug-75d08b.log", append = TRUE),
    error = function(e) invisible(NULL)
  )
}

.f1_exclude_lineage_from_fig12_plots <- function(lg_chr) {
  # Keep comparator set consistent across BCL2 and DNMT1 expression/CERES panels.
  # Keep metastatic TNBC on Figure 1 wide-axis (shown as mTNBC); only exclude localized TNBC.
  drop_set <- c("Localized TNBC", "Localized Sarcoma", "Lymphoma (other)")
  if (exists("f1_extra_locmeta_keep", inherits = TRUE)) {
    ex <- as.character(get("f1_extra_locmeta_keep", inherits = TRUE))
    if (length(ex) == 1L && !is.na(ex) && nzchar(ex)) {
      drop_set <- unique(c(drop_set, "Metastatic prostate"))
    }
  }
  as.character(lg_chr) %in% drop_set
}
.f1_keep_localized_subtype_chr <- function(st_chr) {
  ex <- NA_character_
  if (exists("f1_extra_locmeta_keep", inherits = TRUE)) {
    ex <- as.character(get("f1_extra_locmeta_keep", inherits = TRUE))
    if (length(ex) != 1L || is.na(ex) || !nzchar(ex)) ex <- NA_character_
  }
  grepl("Neuroblastoma", st_chr, fixed = TRUE) |
    grepl("\\bNSCLC\\b", st_chr, ignore.case = TRUE) |
    (!is.na(ex) & st_chr == ex)
}

  .f1_sanitize_lab_rows <- function(df) {
    if (is.null(df) || !is.data.frame(df) || !"lab" %in% names(df) || nrow(df) < 1L) {
      return(df)
    }
    lab_chr <- as.character(df$lab)
    base_chr <- trimws(sub("\\s*N=\\s*.*$", "", lab_chr))
    bad_lab <- is.na(df$lab) |
      !nzchar(trimws(lab_chr)) |
      grepl("^NA\\b", lab_chr) |
      !nzchar(base_chr) |
      grepl("^N=\\s*\\d+$", trimws(lab_chr))
    if (any(bad_lab)) {
      df <- dplyr::filter(df, !bad_lab)
    }
    if (nrow(df) > 0L && is.factor(df$lab)) {
      df$lab <- factor(as.character(df$lab), levels = intersect(levels(df$lab), unique(as.character(df$lab))))
    }
    df
  }

  nb_idx_f1 <- which(lv_f1 %in% nb_lab_set_f1)
  left_labs_f1 <- character(0)
  if (length(ns_idx_f1) > 0L && length(lv_f1) > 0L) {
    k_before_nsclc <- min(ns_idx_f1) - 1L
    if (k_before_nsclc >= 1L) {
      f1_vline_x <- min(ns_idx_f1) - 0.5
      left_labs_f1 <- lv_f1[seq_len(k_before_nsclc)]
    }
  } else if (length(nb_idx_f1) > 0L && length(lv_f1) > 0L) {
    k_right_nb <- max(nb_idx_f1)
    f1_vline_x <- k_right_nb + 0.5
    left_labs_f1 <- lv_f1[seq_len(k_right_nb)]
  }
  if (length(left_labs_f1) > 0L) {
    f1_enriched_lineages <- bcl2_plot_df %>%
      dplyr::filter(as.character(.data$lab) %in% left_labs_f1) %>%
      dplyr::distinct(.data$subtype) %>%
      dplyr::pull(.data$subtype) %>%
      unique() %>%
      as.character()
    # Comparator bucket: never part of stem-like / left-of-line arm
    f1_enriched_lineages <- setdiff(f1_enriched_lineages, "Lymphoma (other)")
    # NSCLC is a non-stem-like lung comparator (right of dashed rule): never part of the stem-like arm
    f1_enriched_lineages <- f1_enriched_lineages[!grepl("NSCLC", f1_enriched_lineages, fixed = TRUE)]
    f1_enriched_lineages <- f1_enriched_lineages[!.f1_exclude_lineage_from_fig12_plots(f1_enriched_lineages)]
    aml_b2_f1 <- dplyr::filter(bcl2_plot_df, as.character(.data$subtype) == "AML (control)") %>% dplyr::pull(.data$BCL2)
    enr_b2_f1 <- dplyr::filter(
      bcl2_plot_df,
      as.character(.data$lab) %in% left_labs_f1,
      as.character(.data$subtype) != "AML (control)"
    ) %>%
      dplyr::pull(.data$BCL2)
    enr_b2_f1 <- as.numeric(stats::na.omit(enr_b2_f1))
    aml_b2_f1 <- as.numeric(stats::na.omit(aml_b2_f1))
    if (length(enr_b2_f1) >= 2L && length(aml_b2_f1) >= 2L) {
      wt_f1 <- tryCatch(
        stats::wilcox.test(enr_b2_f1, aml_b2_f1, alternative = "greater", exact = FALSE),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )
      if (!is.null(wt_f1) && !is.na(wt_f1$p.value)) {
        f1_wilcox_left_aml_p <- unname(wt_f1$p.value)
        pl <- if (f1_wilcox_left_aml_p < 0.001) "<0.001" else format.pval(f1_wilcox_left_aml_p, digits = 3)
        line_txt <- if (length(ns_idx_f1) > 0L) {
          "left of localized/metastatic NSCLC strata"
        } else {
          "right of neuroblastoma strata"
        }
        f1_p_subtitle <- paste0("Red dashed line: ", line_txt, ".")
      }
    }
  }
  f1_vline_leftof_nsclc <- length(ns_idx_f1) > 0L && length(left_labs_f1) > 0L
  f1_enriched_lineages_ordered <- if (length(f1_enriched_lineages) > 0L && exists("lineage_levels")) {
    f1_enriched_lineages[order(match(f1_enriched_lineages, as.character(lineage_levels)))]
  } else {
    character(0)
  }
  # Tighter y window for wide BCL2 expression (top row): cap upper near ~6 log2(TPM+1) so lineage contrasts read larger.
  f1_bcl2_expr_y_hi_cap <- 6.15
  f1_bcl2_expr_ylim <- local({
    yv <- bcl2_plot_df$BCL2
    yv <- yv[is.finite(yv)]
    if (length(yv) < 1L) {
      return(NULL)
    }
    yr <- range(yv)
    d <- diff(yr)
    if (!is.finite(d) || d < 1e-6) d <- 0.35
    pad <- max(0.1, 0.065 * d)
    y_lo <- max(0, yr[1] - pad)
    y_hi <- min(f1_bcl2_expr_y_hi_cap, yr[2] + pad)
    # Widen window to include every finite NEPC BCL2 value (cap can otherwise hide the red dot).
    yn <- bcl2_plot_df$BCL2[bcl2_plot_df$is_nepc %in% TRUE]
    yn <- yn[is.finite(yn)]
    if (length(yn) > 0L) {
      rng_n <- if (length(yn) >= 2L) diff(range(yn)) else 0
      pad_n <- max(0.1, 0.12 * max(rng_n, max(abs(yn), na.rm = TRUE) * 0.08, 0.22))
      y_lo <- max(0, min(y_lo, min(yn) - pad_n))
      y_hi <- max(y_hi, max(yn) + pad_n)
      y_hi <- min(8.5, y_hi)
    }
    if (!is.finite(y_hi) || y_hi <= y_lo) y_hi <- y_lo + 0.45
    c(y_lo, y_hi)
  })
  .mk_bcl2_expr_plot <- function(dat, vline_x = NA_real_, subtitle_txt = NULL) {
    g <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = lab, y = BCL2, fill = subtype)) +
      geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) +
      ggplot2::geom_point(
        data = dplyr::filter(dat, .data$is_nepc %in% TRUE),
        ggplot2::aes(x = lab, y = BCL2),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        color = "#E41A1C",
        position = ggplot2::position_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0),
        alpha = 0.92,
        size = 2.5
      ) +
      ggplot2::scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE, labels = .f1_axis_short_met_label) +
      labs(x = "Lineage", y = "BCL2 expression (log2(TPM+1))") +
      theme_minimal() +
      .f1_fig12_axis_theme(45) +
      theme(legend.position = "none")
    if (!is.na(vline_x)) {
      g <- g + ggplot2::geom_vline(
        xintercept = vline_x,
        linetype = "dashed",
        linewidth = f1_rule_line_linewidth,
        alpha = 1,
        colour = f1_rule_line_colour
      )
    }
    g
  }
  # Wide x-axis: NEPC-only point overlay (red); metastatic tick labels shortened via .f1_axis_short_met_label.
  # Bracket p-values are added in chunk `bcl2-fig-table-dependency` after `similarity-panels` defines fig12_* p-values.
  p_bcl2 <- .mk_bcl2_expr_plot(bcl2_plot_df, vline_x = f1_vline_x, subtitle_txt = NULL)
} else {
  p_bcl2 <- NULL
  p_placeholder <- ggplot() + annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = "Insufficient data for Figure 1 (need ≥2 groups with BCL2). Run Rscript scripts/load_depmap_cache.R then re-knit.", size = 5) + theme_void()
  f1_enriched_lineages_ordered <- character(0)
}

```{r similarity-panels, include = FALSE, cache = FALSE}
# Create BCL2 and DNMT1 similarity panels for use as subfigures in Figure 1 (BCL2) and Figure 2 (DNMT1)
lineage_plastic <- if (exists("lineage_plastic_ref_canonical")) lineage_plastic_ref_canonical else c("SCLC", "ExPulm-SCNEC", "AML (control)")
hma_fig1_b2 <- exists("hma_bcl2_tnbc_lymph_master") && isTRUE(hma_bcl2_tnbc_lymph_master)
lymph_bcl2_context_lbl <- "DLBCL/MCL/CLL"
lineage_bcl2_fig1_multi <- lineage_plastic
if (hma_fig1_b2) {
  lineage_bcl2_fig1_multi <- c(lineage_plastic, lymph_bcl2_context_lbl)
}
# Wide Figure 1: lineages left of dashed vertical rule on Fig. 1 wide axis (NSCLC to the right of line when those strata are shown; else NB rule)
if (exists("f1_enriched_lineages") && length(f1_enriched_lineages) > 0L) {
  lineage_bcl2_fig1_multi <- f1_enriched_lineages
}
lineage_bcl2_fig1_multi <- lineage_bcl2_fig1_multi[!grepl("NSCLC", lineage_bcl2_fig1_multi, fixed = TRUE)]
lineage_bcl2_fig1_multi <- lineage_bcl2_fig1_multi[!.f1_exclude_lineage_from_fig12_plots(lineage_bcl2_fig1_multi)]
lbl_b2_enriched_two <- if (exists("f1_enriched_lineages") && length(f1_enriched_lineages) > 0L) {
  "Stem-like"
} else if (hma_fig1_b2) {
  "Stem-like"
} else {
  "Stem-like (SCLC, ExPulm-SCNEC, AML)"
}
lbl_other_two <- "Non-stem-like"
p_three <- p_two <- p_three_dnmt1 <- p_two_dnmt1 <- NULL
kw_txt <- wx_txt <- kw_dnmt1_txt <- wx_dnmt1_txt <- "—"
ni_aml_expr_note <- ""
cap_bcl2_sim <- "Figure 2b. BCL2 and DNMT1 similarity (see subfigures in Figures 1 and 2)."
if (exists("expr_target") && nrow(expr_target) > 0 && "BCL2" %in% names(expr_target)) {
  bcl2_sim <- expr_target %>% filter(!is.na(BCL2)) %>%
    mutate(is_nepc = (lineage_group == "ExPulm-SCNEC" & dplyr::coalesce(lineage_expulm_detail, "") == "NEPC"))
  lg0 <- as.character(bcl2_sim$lineage_group)
  keep_loc <- .f1_keep_localized_subtype_chr(lg0)
  drop_loc <- grepl("^Localized\\b", lg0) & !keep_loc
  bcl2_sim <- dplyr::filter(bcl2_sim, !drop_loc)
  bcl2_sim <- dplyr::filter(bcl2_sim, !.f1_exclude_lineage_from_fig12_plots(as.character(.data$lineage_group)))
  bcl2_three <- bcl2_sim %>% filter(lineage_group %in% lineage_bcl2_fig1_multi)
  bcl2_sim_two <- bcl2_sim %>%
    mutate(
      in_plastic_grp = (.data$lineage_group %in% lineage_bcl2_fig1_multi) &
        !grepl("NSCLC", as.character(.data$lineage_group), fixed = TRUE),
      group_2 = if_else(in_plastic_grp, lbl_b2_enriched_two, lbl_other_two)
    )
  kw_three <- tryCatch(kruskal.test(BCL2 ~ lineage_group, data = bcl2_three), error = function(e) list(p.value = NA_real_))
  lbl_enr_g2 <- lbl_b2_enriched_two
  lbl_oth_g2 <- lbl_other_two
  vals_b2_enr <- dplyr::filter(bcl2_sim_two, .data$group_2 == lbl_enr_g2) %>% dplyr::pull(.data$BCL2)
  vals_b2_oth <- dplyr::filter(bcl2_sim_two, .data$group_2 == lbl_oth_g2) %>% dplyr::pull(.data$BCL2)
  wx_vs_other <- if (length(stats::na.omit(vals_b2_enr)) >= 1L && length(stats::na.omit(vals_b2_oth)) >= 1L) {
    tryCatch(
      stats::wilcox.test(vals_b2_enr, vals_b2_oth, alternative = "greater", exact = FALSE),
      error = function(e) list(p.value = NA_real_)
    )
  } else {

  }
  kw_p <- kw_three$p.value
  wx_p <- wx_vs_other$p.value
  wx_txt <- if (is.na(wx_p)) "—" else if (wx_p < 0.001) "<0.001" else format.pval(wx_p, digits = 2)
  n_three <- bcl2_three %>% group_by(lineage_group) %>% summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")
  lab_three <- setNames(paste0(gsub(" \\(control\\)", "", as.character(n_three$lineage_group)), " N=", n_three$n), as.character(n_three$lineage_group))
  prio_b <- c("SCLC", "ExPulm-SCNEC", "AML (control)", if (hma_fig1_b2) lymph_bcl2_context_lbl else NULL)

  ord_b <- c(intersect(prio_b, u_b), setdiff(u_b, prio_b))
  bcl2_three <- bcl2_three %>% mutate(lineage_group = factor(as.character(lineage_group), levels = ord_b))
  use_f1_nb_arm <- exists("f1_enriched_lineages") && length(f1_enriched_lineages) > 0L
  ttl_multi <- if (use_f1_nb_arm) {

  } else if (length(ord_b) >= 4L) {

  } else {

  }
  aml_bcl2_vals <- dplyr::filter(bcl2_sim, .data$lineage_group == "AML (control)") %>% dplyr::pull(.data$BCL2)
  ni_bits_expr <- character(0)
  if (exists("f1_wilcox_left_aml_p") && !is.na(f1_wilcox_left_aml_p) && use_f1_nb_arm) {
    plf <- if (f1_wilcox_left_aml_p < 0.001) "<0.001" else format.pval(f1_wilcox_left_aml_p, digits = 3)
    ni_sub_bcl2 <- paste(

        ),
        width = 92
      ),
      collapse = "\n"
    )
    ni_aml_expr_note <- paste0(
      " Combined BCL2 (left of Fig. 1 line",
      if (exists("f1_vline_leftof_nsclc") && isTRUE(f1_vline_leftof_nsclc)) ", NSCLC right of line" else "",
      ", excl. AML) vs AML: p = ", plf, "."
    )
  } else if (length(aml_bcl2_vals) >= 2L) {
    for (lg in ord_b) {
      if (identical(as.character(lg), "AML (control)")) next
      xv <- dplyr::filter(bcl2_sim, as.character(.data$lineage_group) == as.character(lg)) %>% dplyr::pull(.data$BCL2)
      if (length(stats::na.omit(xv)) < 1L) next
      wt <- tryCatch(
        stats::wilcox.test(xv, aml_bcl2_vals, alternative = "greater", exact = FALSE),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )
      if (is.null(wt) || is.na(wt$p.value)) next
      p1 <- unname(wt$p.value)
      pl <- if (p1 < 0.001) "<0.001" else format.pval(p1, digits = 2)
      short_lg <- gsub(" \\(control\\)", "", as.character(lg))
      ni_bits_expr <- c(ni_bits_expr, paste0(short_lg, " p=", pl))
    }
    ni_sub_bcl2 <- if (length(ni_bits_expr) > 0L) {
      paste(strwrap(paste0("vs AML (1-sided Wilcoxon, stochastic ≥ AML): ", paste(ni_bits_expr, collapse = "; ")), width = 92), collapse = "\n")
    } else {
      NULL
    }
    if (length(ni_bits_expr) > 0L) {
      ni_aml_expr_note <- paste0(" BCL2 RNA vs AML (1-sided): ", paste(ni_bits_expr, collapse = "; "), ".")
    }
  } else {
    ni_sub_bcl2 <- NULL
  }
  # Multi-lineage BCL2 panel: corner label = non-inferior vs AML (1-sided), not Kruskal–Wallis
  bcl2_ni_p <- NA_real_
  if (exists("f1_wilcox_left_aml_p") && !is.na(f1_wilcox_left_aml_p) && use_f1_nb_arm) {
    bcl2_ni_p <- f1_wilcox_left_aml_p
  } else if (length(aml_bcl2_vals) >= 2L && nrow(bcl2_three) > 0L) {
    pool_b2_ni <- dplyr::filter(bcl2_three, as.character(.data$lineage_group) != "AML (control)") %>%
      dplyr::pull(.data$BCL2) %>%
      stats::na.omit() %>%

    if (length(pool_b2_ni) >= 2L) {
      wt_ni_b2 <- tryCatch(
        stats::wilcox.test(pool_b2_ni, aml_bcl2_vals, alternative = "greater", exact = FALSE),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )
      if (!is.null(wt_ni_b2) && !is.na(wt_ni_b2$p.value)) {
        bcl2_ni_p <- unname(wt_ni_b2$p.value)
      }
    }
  }
  kw_txt <- if (is.na(bcl2_ni_p)) "—" else if (bcl2_ni_p < 0.001) "<0.001" else format.pval(bcl2_ni_p, digits = 2)
  kw_lab_bcl2 <- if (is.na(bcl2_ni_p)) {
    "NI vs AML: p = —"
  } else {
    paste0("NI vs AML (1-sided): p = ", ifelse(bcl2_ni_p < 0.001, "<0.001", format.pval(bcl2_ni_p, digits = 2)))
  }
  p_three <- ggplot(bcl2_three, aes(x = lineage_group, y = BCL2, fill = lineage_group)) +

  n_two <- bcl2_sim_two %>% group_by(group_2) %>% summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")
  lab_two <- setNames(paste0(as.character(n_two$group_2), " N=", n_two$n), as.character(n_two$group_2))
  wx_lab_bcl2 <- if (is.na(wx_vs_other$p.value)) {

  }
  p_two <- ggplot(bcl2_sim_two, aes(x = group_2, y = BCL2, fill = group_2)) +

    scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#E41A1C", "FALSE" = "gray45"), guide = "none") +
    annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = wx_lab_bcl2, hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.5, size = 5) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = lab_two) +

    theme_minimal() + .f1_fig12_axis_theme(15) + theme(legend.position = "none")
  cap_bcl2_sim <- paste0(
    "Figure 2b. BCL2 and DNMT1 similarity. BCL2 multi-lineage: NI vs AML (1-sided) p = ", kw_txt,
    "; two-group Wilcoxon (stem-like > non-stem-like, 1-sided) p = ", wx_txt, "). DNMT1 (see Figure 2 subfigures).",
    if (nzchar(ni_aml_expr_note)) ni_aml_expr_note else ""
  )
  if (exists("expr_meta_dnmt1") && nrow(expr_meta_dnmt1) > 0 && "DNMT1" %in% names(expr_meta_dnmt1)) {
    dnmt1_sim <- expr_target %>%

      left_join(expr_meta_dnmt1 %>% select(depmap_id, DNMT1), by = "depmap_id") %>%
      filter(!is.na(DNMT1))
    lg0d <- as.character(dnmt1_sim$lineage_group)
    keep_loc_d <- .f1_keep_localized_subtype_chr(lg0d)
    drop_loc_d <- grepl("^Localized\\b", lg0d) & !keep_loc_d
    dnmt1_sim <- dplyr::filter(dnmt1_sim, !drop_loc_d)
    dnmt1_sim <- dplyr::filter(dnmt1_sim, !.f1_exclude_lineage_from_fig12_plots(as.character(.data$lineage_group)))
    lineage_dnmt1_multi <- lineage_bcl2_fig1_multi
    dnmt1_three <- dnmt1_sim %>% filter(lineage_group %in% lineage_dnmt1_multi)
    lbl_dnmt1_enriched_two <- lbl_b2_enriched_two
    dnmt1_sim_two <- dnmt1_sim %>%
      mutate(
        in_plastic_dnmt1 = (.data$lineage_group %in% lineage_dnmt1_multi) &
          !grepl("NSCLC", as.character(.data$lineage_group), fixed = TRUE),
        group_2 = if_else(in_plastic_dnmt1, lbl_dnmt1_enriched_two, lbl_other_two)
      )
    kw_three_dnmt1 <- tryCatch(kruskal.test(DNMT1 ~ lineage_group, data = dnmt1_three), error = function(e) list(p.value = NA_real_))
    wx_vs_other_dnmt1 <- tryCatch(wilcox.test(DNMT1 ~ group_2, data = dnmt1_sim_two), error = function(e) list(p.value = NA_real_))
    # Same arm as Fig. 1 (left of red line, excl. AML) vs AML: 1-sided Wilcoxon, DNMT1 stochastically ≤ AML
    dnmt1_ni_p <- NA_real_
    if (use_f1_nb_arm && exists("f1_enriched_lineages") && length(f1_enriched_lineages) > 0L) {
      pool_dnmt1_ni <- dnmt1_sim %>%
        dplyr::filter(as.character(.data$lineage_group) %in% as.character(f1_enriched_lineages)) %>%
        dplyr::filter(as.character(.data$lineage_group) != "AML (control)") %>%
        dplyr::filter(!grepl("NSCLC", as.character(.data$lineage_group), fixed = TRUE))
      aml_dnmt1_ni <- dnmt1_sim %>% dplyr::filter(.data$lineage_group == "AML (control)")
      pd1 <- stats::na.omit(pool_dnmt1_ni$DNMT1)
      ad1 <- stats::na.omit(aml_dnmt1_ni$DNMT1)
      if (length(pd1) >= 2L && length(ad1) >= 2L) {
        wt_dnmt1_ni <- tryCatch(
          stats::wilcox.test(pd1, ad1, alternative = "less", exact = FALSE),
          error = function(e) NULL
        )
        if (!is.null(wt_dnmt1_ni) && !is.na(wt_dnmt1_ni$p.value)) {
          dnmt1_ni_p <- unname(wt_dnmt1_ni$p.value)
        }
      }
    }
    kw_dnmt1_txt <- if (!is.na(dnmt1_ni_p)) {
      ifelse(dnmt1_ni_p < 0.001, "<0.001", format.pval(dnmt1_ni_p, digits = 2))
    } else if (is.na(kw_three_dnmt1$p.value)) {
      "—"
    } else if (kw_three_dnmt1$p.value < 0.001) {
      "<0.001"
    } else {
      format.pval(kw_three_dnmt1$p.value, digits = 2)
    }
    wx_dnmt1_txt <- if (is.na(wx_vs_other_dnmt1$p.value)) "—" else if (wx_vs_other_dnmt1$p.value < 0.001) "<0.001" else format.pval(wx_vs_other_dnmt1$p.value, digits = 2)
    kw_lab_dnmt1 <- if (!is.na(dnmt1_ni_p)) {
      paste0(
        "NI vs AML (1-sided, ≤ AML): p = ",
        ifelse(dnmt1_ni_p < 0.001, "<0.001", format.pval(dnmt1_ni_p, digits = 2))
      )
    } else if (is.na(kw_three_dnmt1$p.value)) {
      "p = —"
    } else {
      paste0("p = ", ifelse(kw_three_dnmt1$p.value < 0.001, "<0.001", format.pval(kw_three_dnmt1$p.value, digits = 2)))
    }
    n_three_d <- dnmt1_three %>% group_by(lineage_group) %>% summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")
    lab_three_d <- setNames(paste0(gsub(" \\(control\\)", "", as.character(n_three_d$lineage_group)), " N=", n_three_d$n), as.character(n_three_d$lineage_group))
    p_three_dnmt1 <- ggplot(dnmt1_three, aes(x = lineage_group, y = DNMT1, fill = lineage_group)) +
      geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) +
      geom_point(aes(color = is_nepc), position = position_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0), alpha = 0.85, size = 2.5) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#E41A1C", "FALSE" = "gray45"), guide = "none") +
      annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = kw_lab_dnmt1, hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.5, size = 5) +
      scale_x_discrete(labels = lab_three_d) +
      labs(
        x = "Lineage", y = "DNMT1 expression (log2(TPM+1))",
        title = if (length(unique(dnmt1_three$lineage_group)) >= 4L) "DNMT1 (four lineages)" else "DNMT1 (three lineages)"
      ) +
      theme_minimal() + .f1_fig12_axis_theme(25) + theme(legend.position = "none")
    n_two_d <- dnmt1_sim_two %>% group_by(group_2) %>% summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")
    lab_two_d <- setNames(paste0(as.character(n_two_d$group_2), " N=", n_two_d$n), as.character(n_two_d$group_2))
    wx_lab_dnmt1 <- if (is.na(wx_vs_other_dnmt1$p.value)) "p = —" else paste0("p = ", ifelse(wx_vs_other_dnmt1$p.value < 0.001, "<0.001", format.pval(wx_vs_other_dnmt1$p.value, digits = 2)))
    p_two_dnmt1 <- ggplot(dnmt1_sim_two, aes(x = group_2, y = DNMT1, fill = group_2)) +
      geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) +
      geom_point(aes(color = is_nepc), position = position_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0), alpha = 0.85, size = 2.5) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#E41A1C", "FALSE" = "gray45"), guide = "none") +
      annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = wx_lab_dnmt1, hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.5, size = 5) +
      scale_x_discrete(labels = lab_two_d) +
      labs(x = "", y = "DNMT1 expression (log2(TPM+1))", title = "DNMT1 (two groups)") +
      theme_minimal() + .f1_fig12_axis_theme(15) + theme(legend.position = "none")
    cap_bcl2_sim <- paste0(
      "Figure 2b. BCL2 and DNMT1 similarity. BCL2 multi-lineage: NI vs AML (1-sided) p = ", kw_txt, "; two-group (1-sided) p = ", wx_txt, ". DNMT1 multi-lineage: ",
      if (!is.na(dnmt1_ni_p)) {
        paste0("NI vs AML (1-sided, DNMT1 ≤ AML) p = ", kw_dnmt1_txt)
      } else {
        paste0("Kruskal–Wallis p = ", kw_dnmt1_txt)
      },
      "; two-group Wilcoxon p = ", wx_dnmt1_txt, ").",
      if (nzchar(ni_aml_expr_note)) ni_aml_expr_note else ""
    )
  }
}

```{r ceres-similarity-panels, include = FALSE, cache = FALSE}
# BCL2 and DNMT1 CERES similarity panels (stem-like lineages + two-group) and broad DNMT1 CERES for Figure 2
lineage_plastic_ceres <- if (exists("lineage_plastic_ref_canonical")) lineage_plastic_ref_canonical else c("SCLC", "ExPulm-SCNEC", "AML (control)")
lbl_b2_ceres_two <- if (exists("lbl_b2_enriched_two")) lbl_b2_enriched_two else "Stem-like (SCLC, ExPulm-SCNEC, AML)"
lineage_bcl2_ceres_multi <- if (exists("lineage_bcl2_fig1_multi")) lineage_bcl2_fig1_multi else lineage_plastic_ceres
ni_aml_ceres_note <- ""
p_three_bcl2_ceres <- p_two_bcl2_ceres <- p_three_dnmt1_ceres <- p_two_dnmt1_ceres <- p_dnmt1_ceres <- NULL
dnmt1_ceres_plot_df <- NULL
# BCL2 CERES: build crispr_bcl2 (same as 08) then multi-lineage + two panels (aligned with BCL2 expression Figure 1)
if (exists("crispr") && nrow(crispr) > 0 && exists("target_ids") && length(target_ids) > 0 && exists("expr_target")) {
  crispr_bcl2 <- crispr %>%
    filter(grepl("^BCL2\\b", gene_name), depmap_id %in% target_ids) %>%
    select(depmap_id, cell_line, dependency) %>%
    left_join(expr_target %>% select(depmap_id, lineage_group, dplyr::any_of("lineage_expulm_detail")), by = "depmap_id") %>%
    filter(!is.na(lineage_group)) %>%
    mutate(is_nepc = (lineage_group == "ExPulm-SCNEC" & dplyr::coalesce(lineage_expulm_detail, "") == "NEPC"))
  lg0c <- as.character(crispr_bcl2$lineage_group)
  keep_loc_c <- .f1_keep_localized_subtype_chr(lg0c)
  drop_loc_c <- grepl("^Localized\\b", lg0c) & !keep_loc_c
  crispr_bcl2 <- dplyr::filter(crispr_bcl2, !drop_loc_c)
  crispr_bcl2 <- dplyr::filter(crispr_bcl2, !.f1_exclude_lineage_from_fig12_plots(as.character(.data$lineage_group)))
  if (nrow(crispr_bcl2) >= 2) {
    bcl2_three_ceres <- crispr_bcl2 %>%
      dplyr::filter(.data$lineage_group %in% lineage_bcl2_ceres_multi, is.finite(.data$dependency))
    bcl2_sim_two_ceres <- crispr_bcl2 %>%
      mutate(
        in_plastic_ceres = (.data$lineage_group %in% lineage_bcl2_ceres_multi) &
          !grepl("NSCLC", as.character(.data$lineage_group), fixed = TRUE),
        group_2 = if_else(in_plastic_ceres, lbl_b2_ceres_two, lbl_other_two)
      ) %>%
      dplyr::filter(is.finite(.data$dependency))
    kw_bcl2 <- tryCatch(kruskal.test(dependency ~ lineage_group, data = bcl2_three_ceres), error = function(e) list(p.value = NA_real_))
    wx_bcl2 <- tryCatch(wilcox.test(dependency ~ group_2, data = bcl2_sim_two_ceres), error = function(e) list(p.value = NA_real_))
    n_three_bc <- bcl2_three_ceres %>% group_by(lineage_group) %>% summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")
    lab_three_bc <- setNames(paste0(gsub(" \\(control\\)", "", as.character(n_three_bc$lineage_group)), " N=", n_three_bc$n), as.character(n_three_bc$lineage_group))
    lymph_lbl_c <- "DLBCL/MCL/CLL"
    u_c <- unique(as.character(bcl2_three_ceres$lineage_group))
    prio_c <- c("SCLC", "ExPulm-SCNEC", "AML (control)")
    if (lymph_lbl_c %in% u_c) prio_c <- c(prio_c, lymph_lbl_c)
    ord_c <- c(intersect(prio_c, u_c), setdiff(u_c, prio_c))
    bcl2_three_ceres <- bcl2_three_ceres %>% mutate(lineage_group = factor(as.character(lineage_group), levels = ord_c))
    ttl_ceres_multi <- if (length(ord_c) >= 4L) "BCL2 CERES (four lineages)" else "BCL2 CERES (three lineages)"
    aml_ceres_vals <- dplyr::filter(crispr_bcl2, .data$lineage_group == "AML (control)", is.finite(.data$dependency)) %>%
      dplyr::pull(.data$dependency)
    # Single pooled NI p: all non-AML lineages in Fig. 1 arm (or multi-panel lineages) vs AML; greater = stochastically more positive CERES (not more dependent)
    bcl2_ceres_ni_p <- NA_real_
    lg_pool_ceres <- if (exists("f1_enriched_lineages") && length(f1_enriched_lineages) > 0L) {
      as.character(f1_enriched_lineages)
    } else {
      as.character(lineage_bcl2_ceres_multi)
    }
    lg_pool_ceres <- lg_pool_ceres[!grepl("NSCLC", lg_pool_ceres, fixed = TRUE)]
    lg_pool_ceres <- lg_pool_ceres[!.f1_exclude_lineage_from_fig12_plots(lg_pool_ceres)]
    pool_bcl2_ceres <- crispr_bcl2 %>%
      dplyr::filter(as.character(.data$lineage_group) %in% lg_pool_ceres) %>%
      dplyr::filter(as.character(.data$lineage_group) != "AML (control)") %>%
      dplyr::filter(is.finite(.data$dependency))
    pbc <- stats::na.omit(pool_bcl2_ceres$dependency)
    abc <- stats::na.omit(aml_ceres_vals)
    if (length(pbc) >= 2L && length(abc) >= 2L) {
      wt_bcer <- tryCatch(
        stats::wilcox.test(pbc, abc, alternative = "greater", exact = FALSE),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )
      if (!is.null(wt_bcer) && !is.na(wt_bcer$p.value)) {
        bcl2_ceres_ni_p <- unname(wt_bcer$p.value)
      }
    }
    kw_lab_bcl2 <- if (!is.na(bcl2_ceres_ni_p)) {
      paste0(
        "NI vs AML (1-sided, less BCL2-dependent: combined non-AML lineages, CERES ≥ AML): p = ",
        ifelse(bcl2_ceres_ni_p < 0.001, "<0.001", format.pval(bcl2_ceres_ni_p, digits = 2))
      )
    } else if (is.na(kw_bcl2$p.value)) {
      "p = —"
    } else {
      paste0("p = ", ifelse(kw_bcl2$p.value < 0.001, "<0.001", format.pval(kw_bcl2$p.value, digits = 2)))
    }
    ni_sub_bcl2_ceres <- NULL
    if (!is.na(bcl2_ceres_ni_p)) {
      pln <- if (bcl2_ceres_ni_p < 0.001) "<0.001" else format.pval(bcl2_ceres_ni_p, digits = 2)
      ni_aml_ceres_note <- paste0(
        " BCL2 CERES vs AML (1-sided Wilcoxon, alternative: combined non-AML ≥ AML; more positive CERES = less BCL2-dependent): p = ",
        pln, "."
      )
    }
    p_three_bcl2_ceres <- ggplot(bcl2_three_ceres, aes(x = lineage_group, y = dependency, fill = lineage_group)) +
      geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
      geom_point(aes(color = is_nepc), position = position_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0), alpha = 0.85, size = 2.5) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#E41A1C", "FALSE" = "gray45"), guide = "none") +
      annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = kw_lab_bcl2, hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.5, size = 5) +
      scale_x_discrete(labels = lab_three_bc) +
      labs(x = "Lineage", y = "BCL2 CERES", title = ttl_ceres_multi, subtitle = ni_sub_bcl2_ceres) +
      theme_minimal() + .f1_fig12_axis_theme(25) + theme(legend.position = "none", plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 20, lineheight = 1.05))
    n_two_bc <- bcl2_sim_two_ceres %>% group_by(group_2) %>% summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")
    lab_two_bc <- setNames(paste0(as.character(n_two_bc$group_2), " N=", n_two_bc$n), as.character(n_two_bc$group_2))
    wx_lab_bcl2 <- if (is.na(wx_bcl2$p.value)) "p = —" else paste0("p = ", ifelse(wx_bcl2$p.value < 0.001, "<0.001", format.pval(wx_bcl2$p.value, digits = 2)))
    p_two_bcl2_ceres <- ggplot(bcl2_sim_two_ceres, aes(x = group_2, y = dependency, fill = group_2)) +
      geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
      geom_point(aes(color = is_nepc), position = position_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0), alpha = 0.85, size = 2.5) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#E41A1C", "FALSE" = "gray45"), guide = "none") +
      annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = wx_lab_bcl2, hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.5, size = 5) +
      scale_x_discrete(labels = lab_two_bc) +
      labs(x = "", y = "BCL2 CERES", title = "BCL2 CERES (two groups)") +
      theme_minimal() + .f1_fig12_axis_theme(15) + theme(legend.position = "none")
  }
}

# DNMT1 CERES: three/two panels + broad by-lineage plot for Figure 2
if (exists("crispr_dnmt1") && nrow(crispr_dnmt1) > 0 && exists("expr_target")) {
  key_lineages_dnmt1 <- c("SCLC", "ExPulm-SCNEC", "AML (control)")
  tnbc_lymph_dnmt1_ceres <- c(
    if (exists("cohort_extended_hem") && isTRUE(cohort_extended_hem)) {
      c(
        if (exists("lineage_levels_tnbc")) {
          setdiff(lineage_levels_tnbc, "Unspecified TNBC")
        } else {
          c("Localized TNBC", "Metastatic TNBC")
        },
        "DLBCL/MCL/CLL"
      )
    } else {
      character(0)
    },
    "Neuroblastoma", "Unspecified Neuroblastoma"
  )
  tnbc_lymph_dnmt1_ceres <- setdiff(
    tnbc_lymph_dnmt1_ceres,
    c("Localized TNBC", "Localized Sarcoma", "Lymphoma (other)")
  )
  crispr_dnmt1 <- crispr_dnmt1 %>%
    left_join(expr_target %>% select(depmap_id, dplyr::any_of("lineage_expulm_detail")), by = "depmap_id") %>%
    mutate(is_nepc = (lineage_group == "ExPulm-SCNEC" & dplyr::coalesce(lineage_expulm_detail, "") == "NEPC"))
  lg0dn <- as.character(crispr_dnmt1$lineage_group)
  keep_loc_dn <- .f1_keep_localized_subtype_chr(lg0dn)
  drop_loc_dn <- grepl("^Localized\\b", lg0dn) & !keep_loc_dn
  crispr_dnmt1 <- dplyr::filter(crispr_dnmt1, !drop_loc_dn)
  crispr_dnmt1 <- dplyr::filter(crispr_dnmt1, !.f1_exclude_lineage_from_fig12_plots(as.character(.data$lineage_group)))
  lineage_dnmt1_ceres_multi <- if (exists("lineage_bcl2_ceres_multi")) lineage_bcl2_ceres_multi else lineage_plastic_ceres
  lbl_dnmt1_ceres_two <- if (exists("lbl_b2_enriched_two")) lbl_b2_enriched_two else "Stem-like (SCLC, ExPulm-SCNEC, AML)"
  lbl_dnmt1_ceres_other <- if (exists("lbl_other_two")) lbl_other_two else "Non-stem-like"
  dnmt1_three_ceres <- crispr_dnmt1 %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$lineage_group %in% lineage_dnmt1_ceres_multi, is.finite(.data$dependency))
  dnmt1_sim_two_ceres <- crispr_dnmt1 %>%
    mutate(
      in_plastic_dnmt1_ceres = (.data$lineage_group %in% lineage_dnmt1_ceres_multi) &
        !grepl("NSCLC", as.character(.data$lineage_group), fixed = TRUE),
      group_2 = if_else(in_plastic_dnmt1_ceres, lbl_dnmt1_ceres_two, lbl_dnmt1_ceres_other)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.finite(.data$dependency))
  if (nrow(dnmt1_three_ceres) >= 2) {
    kw_dnmt1 <- tryCatch(kruskal.test(dependency ~ lineage_group, data = dnmt1_three_ceres), error = function(e) list(p.value = NA_real_))
    wx_dnmt1 <- tryCatch(wilcox.test(dependency ~ group_2, data = dnmt1_sim_two_ceres), error = function(e) list(p.value = NA_real_))
    dnmt1_ceres_ni_p <- NA_real_
    if (exists("f1_enriched_lineages") && length(f1_enriched_lineages) > 0L) {
      pool_dc <- crispr_dnmt1 %>%
        dplyr::filter(as.character(.data$lineage_group) %in% as.character(f1_enriched_lineages)) %>%
        dplyr::filter(as.character(.data$lineage_group) != "AML (control)") %>%
        dplyr::filter(!grepl("NSCLC", as.character(.data$lineage_group), fixed = TRUE)) %>%
        dplyr::filter(is.finite(.data$dependency))
      aml_dc <- crispr_dnmt1 %>%
        dplyr::filter(.data$lineage_group == "AML (control)", is.finite(.data$dependency))
      pdc <- stats::na.omit(pool_dc$dependency)
      adc <- stats::na.omit(aml_dc$dependency)
      if (length(pdc) >= 2L && length(adc) >= 2L) {
        wt_dc <- tryCatch(
          stats::wilcox.test(pdc, adc, alternative = "greater", exact = FALSE),
          error = function(e) NULL
        )
        if (!is.null(wt_dc) && !is.na(wt_dc$p.value)) {
          dnmt1_ceres_ni_p <- unname(wt_dc$p.value)
        }
      }
    }
    kw_lab_dnmt1 <- if (!is.na(dnmt1_ceres_ni_p)) {
      paste0(
        "NI vs AML (1-sided, less DNMT1-dependent: combined non-AML lineages, CERES ≥ AML): p = ",
        ifelse(dnmt1_ceres_ni_p < 0.001, "<0.001", format.pval(dnmt1_ceres_ni_p, digits = 2))
      )
    } else if (is.na(kw_dnmt1$p.value)) {
      "p = —"
    } else {
      paste0("p = ", ifelse(kw_dnmt1$p.value < 0.001, "<0.001", format.pval(kw_dnmt1$p.value, digits = 2)))
    }
    n_three_dc <- dnmt1_three_ceres %>% group_by(lineage_group) %>% summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")
    lab_three_dc <- setNames(paste0(gsub(" \\(control\\)", "", as.character(n_three_dc$lineage_group)), " N=", n_three_dc$n), as.character(n_three_dc$lineage_group))
    p_three_dnmt1_ceres <- ggplot(dnmt1_three_ceres, aes(x = lineage_group, y = dependency, fill = lineage_group)) +
      geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
      geom_point(aes(color = is_nepc), position = position_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0), alpha = 0.85, size = 2.5) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#E41A1C", "FALSE" = "gray45"), guide = "none") +
      annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = kw_lab_dnmt1, hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.5, size = 5) +
      scale_x_discrete(labels = lab_three_dc) +
      labs(
        x = "Lineage", y = "DNMT1 CERES",
        title = if (length(unique(dnmt1_three_ceres$lineage_group)) >= 4L) {
          "DNMT1 CERES (four lineages)"
        } else {
          "DNMT1 CERES (three lineages)"
        }
      ) +
      theme_minimal() + .f1_fig12_axis_theme(25) + theme(legend.position = "none")
    n_two_dc <- dnmt1_sim_two_ceres %>% group_by(group_2) %>% summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")
    lab_two_dc <- setNames(paste0(as.character(n_two_dc$group_2), " N=", n_two_dc$n), as.character(n_two_dc$group_2))
    wx_lab_dnmt1 <- if (is.na(wx_dnmt1$p.value)) "p = —" else paste0("p = ", ifelse(wx_dnmt1$p.value < 0.001, "<0.001", format.pval(wx_dnmt1$p.value, digits = 2)))
    p_two_dnmt1_ceres <- ggplot(dnmt1_sim_two_ceres, aes(x = group_2, y = dependency, fill = group_2)) +
      geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
      geom_point(aes(color = is_nepc), position = position_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0), alpha = 0.85, size = 2.5) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#E41A1C", "FALSE" = "gray45"), guide = "none") +
      annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = wx_lab_dnmt1, hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.5, size = 5) +
      scale_x_discrete(labels = lab_two_dc) +
      labs(x = "", y = "DNMT1 CERES", title = "DNMT1 CERES (two groups)") +
      theme_minimal() + .f1_fig12_axis_theme(15) + theme(legend.position = "none")
  }
  # Broad DNMT1 CERES by lineage (for Figure 2 bottom-left)
  dnmt1_crispr_n <- crispr_dnmt1 %>% group_by(lineage_group) %>% summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")
  dnmt1_keep <- dnmt1_crispr_n %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      n >= 5 |
        .data$lineage_group == "ExPulm-SCNEC" |
        as.character(.data$lineage_group) %in% tnbc_lymph_dnmt1_ceres
    ) %>%
    dplyr::pull(.data$lineage_group)
  if (exists("bcl2_plot_df") && is.data.frame(bcl2_plot_df) && nrow(bcl2_plot_df) > 0L && "subtype" %in% names(bcl2_plot_df)) {
    axis_sub_d <- unique(as.character(bcl2_plot_df$subtype))
    in_dn <- unique(as.character(crispr_dnmt1$lineage_group))
    dnmt1_keep <- union(dnmt1_keep, intersect(axis_sub_d, in_dn))
  }
  # #region agent log
  tryCatch({
    .agent_dbg_ndjson(
      runId = "post-fix",
      hypothesisId = "H4",
      location = "03_Rmd:dnmt1_keep",
      message = "DNMT1 keep set and neuroblastoma availability pre-join",
      data = list(
        dnmt1_keep = as.character(dnmt1_keep),
        in_dn_nb = sum(grepl("Neuroblastoma", as.character(crispr_dnmt1$lineage_group), fixed = TRUE))
      )
    )
  }, error = function(e) invisible(NULL))
  # #endregion
  crispr_dnmt1_plot <- crispr_dnmt1 %>% dplyr::filter(lineage_group %in% dnmt1_keep)
  p_dnmt1_ceres <- NULL
  if (nrow(crispr_dnmt1_plot) > 0) {
    if (exists("bcl2_plot_df") && is.data.frame(bcl2_plot_df) &&
          nrow(bcl2_plot_df) > 0L &&
          all(c("depmap_id", "lab", "subtype") %in% names(bcl2_plot_df))) {
      axis_dn <- bcl2_plot_df %>%
        dplyr::distinct(.data$depmap_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
        dplyr::select(.data$depmap_id, .data$lab, .data$subtype, .data$is_nepc)
      crispr_d_dep <- crispr_dnmt1_plot %>%
        dplyr::select(.data$depmap_id, .data$dependency)
      ddj <- axis_dn %>%
        dplyr::left_join(crispr_d_dep, by = "depmap_id")
      if (nrow(ddj) >= 2L) {
        lev_dn <- levels(bcl2_plot_df$lab)
        ddj <- ddj %>%
          dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data$lab), nzchar(trimws(as.character(.data$lab))))
        ddj$lab <- factor(as.character(ddj$lab), levels = lev_dn)
        ddj <- ddj %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data$lab))
        ddj <- dplyr::filter(ddj, is.finite(.data$dependency))
        # #region agent log
        tryCatch({
          nb_ddj <- ddj %>% dplyr::filter(grepl("Neuroblastoma", as.character(.data$lab), fixed = TRUE))
          .agent_dbg_ndjson(
            runId = "post-fix",
            hypothesisId = "H5",
            location = "03_Rmd:dnmt1_ddj_finite",
            message = "DNMT1 wide CERES rows after finite filter",
            data = list(
              n_rows = nrow(ddj),
              n_nb_rows = nrow(nb_ddj),
              nb_labs = unique(as.character(nb_ddj$lab))
            )
          )
        }, error = function(e) invisible(NULL))
        # #endregion
        n_dnmt1_ceres_by_lab <- setNames(rep(0L, length(lev_dn)), lev_dn)
        if (nrow(ddj) > 0L && "lab" %in% names(ddj)) {
          cn_d1 <- ddj %>% dplyr::count(.data$lab, name = "nn")
          for (ri in seq_len(nrow(cn_d1))) {
            k <- as.character(cn_d1$lab[[ri]])
            if (k %in% names(n_dnmt1_ceres_by_lab)) {
              n_dnmt1_ceres_by_lab[[k]] <- as.integer(cn_d1$nn[[ri]])
            }
          }
        }
        f1_dnmt1_ceres_labels_fun <- .f1_ceres_wide_x_labeller(n_dnmt1_ceres_by_lab)
        if (nrow(ddj) >= 2L) {
          f1_dnmt1_ceres_ylim <- local({
            yv <- ddj$dependency
            yv <- yv[is.finite(yv)]
            yn <- ddj$dependency[ddj$is_nepc %in% TRUE]
            yn <- yn[is.finite(yn)]
            if (length(yv) < 2L) {
              # Still define limits so y=0 reference and any finite NEPC overlay are visible.
              pad0 <- 0.14
              if (length(yn) >= 1L) {
                y_lo0 <- min(min(yn) - pad0, -pad0)
                y_hi0 <- max(max(yn) + pad0, pad0)
                return(c(max(-4.8, y_lo0), min(1.2, y_hi0)))
              }
              return(c(-0.35, 0.35))
            }
            qs <- stats::quantile(yv, c(0.04, 0.96), names = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE)
            d <- diff(qs)
            if (!is.finite(d) || d < 0.18) d <- max(0.42, diff(range(yv)))
            pad <- max(0.07, 0.14 * d)
            y_lo <- max(-3.15, qs[[1L]] - pad)
            y_hi <- min(0.62, qs[[2L]] + pad)
            # Always include finite NEPC overlay CERES so coord_cartesian does not clip the red points.
            if (length(yn) > 0L) {
              rng_n <- if (length(yn) >= 2L) diff(range(yn)) else 0
              pad_n <- max(0.08, 0.12 * max(rng_n, max(abs(yn), na.rm = TRUE) * 0.12, 0.2))
              y_lo <- min(y_lo, min(yn) - pad_n)
              y_hi <- max(y_hi, max(yn) + pad_n)
              y_lo <- max(-4.6, y_lo)
              y_hi <- min(1.15, y_hi)
            }
            # CERES panels: always span y=0 (dashed reference).
            pad0 <- 0.12
            y_lo <- min(y_lo, -pad0)
            y_hi <- max(y_hi, pad0)
            y_lo <- max(-4.85, y_lo)
            y_hi <- min(1.25, y_hi)
            if (!is.finite(y_hi) || y_hi <= y_lo) {
              return(NULL)
            }
            c(y_lo, y_hi)
          })
          kw_dnmt1_broad <- tryCatch(
            stats::kruskal.test(dependency ~ lab, data = ddj),
            error = function(e) list(p.value = NA_real_)
          )
          p_kw_dnmt1 <- if (!is.null(kw_dnmt1_broad$p.value) && !is.na(kw_dnmt1_broad$p.value)) {
            format.pval(kw_dnmt1_broad$p.value, digits = 2)
          } else {
            "—"
          }
          vx_ddj <- if (exists("f1_vline_x")) f1_vline_x else NA_real_
          p_dnmt1_ceres <- ggplot(ddj, aes(x = lab, y = dependency, fill = subtype)) +
            geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA, na.rm = TRUE) +
            geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
            ggplot2::geom_point(
              data = dplyr::filter(ddj, .data$is_nepc %in% TRUE),
              ggplot2::aes(x = lab, y = dependency),
              inherit.aes = FALSE,
              color = "#E41A1C",
              position = ggplot2::position_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0),
              alpha = 0.92,
              size = 2.5,
              na.rm = TRUE
            )
          if (!is.na(vx_ddj)) {
            p_dnmt1_ceres <- p_dnmt1_ceres + ggplot2::geom_vline(
              xintercept = vx_ddj,
              linetype = "dashed",
              linewidth = f1_rule_line_linewidth,
              alpha = 1,
              colour = f1_rule_line_colour
            )
          }
          p_dnmt1_ceres <- p_dnmt1_ceres +
            ggplot2::scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE, labels = f1_dnmt1_ceres_labels_fun) +
            labs(x = "Lineage", y = "DNMT1 CERES") +
            theme_minimal() +
            .f1_fig12_axis_theme(45) +
            theme(legend.position = "none")
          dnmt1_ceres_plot_df <- ddj
        }
      }
    }
    if (is.null(p_dnmt1_ceres)) {
      u_d <- unique(as.character(crispr_dnmt1_plot$lineage_group))
      prio_d <- c(key_lineages_dnmt1, tnbc_lymph_dnmt1_ceres)
      ord_d <- c(intersect(prio_d, u_d), setdiff(u_d, prio_d))
      crispr_dnmt1_plot <- crispr_dnmt1_plot %>%
        mutate(lineage_group = factor(as.character(lineage_group), levels = ord_d))
      crispr_dnmt1_plot_fin <- dplyr::filter(crispr_dnmt1_plot, is.finite(.data$dependency))
      kw_dnmt1_broad <- tryCatch(kruskal.test(dependency ~ lineage_group, data = crispr_dnmt1_plot_fin), error = function(e) list(p.value = NA))
      p_kw_dnmt1 <- if (!is.null(kw_dnmt1_broad$p.value)) format.pval(kw_dnmt1_broad$p.value, digits = 2) else "—"
      lbl_dnmt1 <- crispr_dnmt1_plot_fin %>% group_by(lineage_group) %>% summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")
      lab_dnmt1_ceres <- setNames(paste0(gsub(" \\(control\\)", "", as.character(lbl_dnmt1$lineage_group)), " N=", lbl_dnmt1$n), as.character(lbl_dnmt1$lineage_group))
      p_dnmt1_ceres <- ggplot(crispr_dnmt1_plot_fin, aes(x = lineage_group, y = dependency, fill = lineage_group)) +
        geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) +
        geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
        geom_point(aes(color = is_nepc), position = position_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0), alpha = 0.85, size = 2.5) +
        scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#E41A1C", "FALSE" = "gray45"), guide = "none") +
        scale_x_discrete(labels = lab_dnmt1_ceres) +
        labs(x = "Lineage", y = "DNMT1 CERES") +
        theme_minimal() + .f1_fig12_axis_theme(45) + theme(legend.position = "none")
      dnmt1_ceres_plot_df <- dplyr::transmute(
        crispr_dnmt1_plot_fin,
        lab = as.character(.data$lineage_group),
        subtype = as.character(.data$lineage_group),
        dependency = .data$dependency
      )
      vx_dfb <- if (exists("f1_vline_x")) f1_vline_x else NA_real_
      if (!is.na(vx_dfb) && exists("bcl2_plot_df") && nrow(bcl2_plot_df) > 0L &&
            length(ord_d) == length(levels(bcl2_plot_df$lab))) {
        p_dnmt1_ceres <- p_dnmt1_ceres + ggplot2::geom_vline(
          xintercept = vx_dfb,
          linetype = "dashed",
          linewidth = f1_rule_line_linewidth,
          alpha = 1,
          colour = f1_rule_line_colour
        )
      }
    }
  }
}
fig12_dnmt1_ceres_ni_p <- if (exists("dnmt1_ceres_ni_p")) dnmt1_ceres_ni_p else NA_real_
fig12_dnmt1_ceres_two_p <- if (exists("wx_dnmt1")) wx_dnmt1$p.value else NA_real_
if (exists("cap_bcl2_sim") && exists("ni_aml_ceres_note") && nzchar(ni_aml_ceres_note)) {
  cap_bcl2_sim <- paste0(cap_bcl2_sim, ni_aml_ceres_note)
}

```{r bcl2-fig-table-dependency, cache = FALSE, fig.show = "hide"}
# Build BCL2 dependency plot (CERES) for Figure 1 composite
p_bcl2_ceres <- NULL
if (exists("crispr") && nrow(crispr) > 0 && exists("target_ids") && length(target_ids) > 0 && exists("expr_target")) {
  crispr_bcl2_f1 <- crispr %>%
    filter(grepl("^BCL2\\b", gene_name), depmap_id %in% target_ids) %>%
    select(depmap_id, dependency) %>%
    left_join(expr_target %>% select(depmap_id, lineage_group, dplyr::any_of("lineage_expulm_detail")), by = "depmap_id") %>%
    filter(!is.na(lineage_group)) %>%
    mutate(is_nepc = (lineage_group == "ExPulm-SCNEC" & dplyr::coalesce(lineage_expulm_detail, "") == "NEPC"))
  crispr_bcl2_f1 <- crispr_bcl2_f1 %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !grepl("^Localized\\b", as.character(.data$lineage_group)) |
        .f1_keep_localized_subtype_chr(as.character(.data$lineage_group))
    )
  crispr_bcl2_f1 <- dplyr::filter(crispr_bcl2_f1, !.f1_exclude_lineage_from_fig12_plots(as.character(.data$lineage_group)))
  if (nrow(crispr_bcl2_f1) > 0) {
    # Lymphoma + neuroblastoma: always allow in wide CERES (n<5 anchor), like expression panel
    tnbc_lymph_ceres <- c(
      if (exists("cohort_extended_hem") && isTRUE(cohort_extended_hem)) {
        if (exists("lineage_levels_tnbc")) {
          setdiff(lineage_levels_tnbc, "Unspecified TNBC")
        } else {
          c("Localized TNBC", "Metastatic TNBC")
        }
      } else {
        character(0)
      },
      "DLBCL/MCL/CLL",
      "Neuroblastoma", "Unspecified Neuroblastoma",
      "Localized Sarcoma", "Metastatic Sarcoma", "Unspecified Sarcoma"
    )
    tnbc_lymph_ceres <- setdiff(
      tnbc_lymph_ceres,
      c("Localized TNBC", "Localized Sarcoma", "Lymphoma (other)")
    )
    c_n <- crispr_bcl2_f1 %>% group_by(lineage_group) %>% summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")
    keep_l <- c_n %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        n >= 5 |
          as.character(.data$lineage_group) == "ExPulm-SCNEC" |
          as.character(.data$lineage_group) %in% tnbc_lymph_ceres
      ) %>%
      dplyr::pull(.data$lineage_group)
    # Keep CRISPR rows for any lineage present on the Figure 1 expression axis (avoids empty CERES slots when n < 5).
    if (exists("bcl2_plot_df") && is.data.frame(bcl2_plot_df) && nrow(bcl2_plot_df) > 0L && "subtype" %in% names(bcl2_plot_df)) {
      axis_sub <- unique(as.character(bcl2_plot_df$subtype))
      in_crispr <- unique(as.character(crispr_bcl2_f1$lineage_group))
      keep_l <- union(keep_l, intersect(axis_sub, in_crispr))
    }
    # #region agent log
    tryCatch({
      .agent_dbg_ndjson(
        runId = "post-fix",
        hypothesisId = "H2",
        location = "03_Rmd:bcl2_keep_l",
        message = "BCL2 CERES lineage keep set and neuroblastoma availability",
        data = list(
          keep_l = as.character(keep_l),
          in_crispr_nb = sum(grepl("Neuroblastoma", as.character(crispr_bcl2_f1$lineage_group), fixed = TRUE)),
          axis_nb_lab = unique(as.character(bcl2_plot_df$lab[grepl("Neuroblastoma", as.character(bcl2_plot_df$lab), fixed = TRUE)]))
        )
      )
    }, error = function(e) invisible(NULL))
    # #endregion
    crispr_bcl2_f1 <- crispr_bcl2_f1 %>% filter(lineage_group %in% keep_l)
    if (nrow(crispr_bcl2_f1) > 0) {
      use_bcl2_axis <- exists("bcl2_plot_df") && is.data.frame(bcl2_plot_df) &&
        nrow(bcl2_plot_df) > 0L &&
        all(c("lab", "subtype", "depmap_id") %in% names(bcl2_plot_df))
      if (use_bcl2_axis) {
        bcl2_axis_c <- bcl2_plot_df %>%
          dplyr::distinct(.data$depmap_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
          dplyr::select(.data$depmap_id, .data$lab, .data$subtype, .data$is_nepc)
        crispr_dep <- crispr_bcl2_f1 %>%
          dplyr::select(.data$depmap_id, .data$dependency)
        # Same cell lines as expression (left join) so every lineage slot can draw CERES when values exist.
        ceres_f1_df <- bcl2_axis_c %>%
          dplyr::left_join(crispr_dep, by = "depmap_id")
        if (nrow(ceres_f1_df) >= 2L) {
          ceres_f1_df <- ceres_f1_df %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data$lab), nzchar(trimws(as.character(.data$lab))))
          lev_lab <- levels(bcl2_plot_df$lab)
          if (length(lev_lab) > 0L) {

          }

            .agent_dbg_ndjson(

          if (nrow(ceres_f1_df) > 0L && "lab" %in% names(ceres_f1_df)) {

            for (ri in seq_len(nrow(cn_b1))) {
              k <- as.character(cn_b1$lab[[ri]])
              if (k %in% names(n_ceres_f1_by_lab)) {
                n_ceres_f1_by_lab[[k]] <- as.integer(cn_b1$nn[[ri]])
              }
            }
          }
          f1_bcl2_ceres_labels_fun <- .f1_ceres_wide_x_labeller(n_ceres_f1_by_lab)
          if (nrow(ceres_f1_df) >= 2L) {
            # Top-row BCL2 CERES: slightly tighter y than default limits so contrasts read larger (still shows ~0 reference).
            f1_bcl2_ceres_ylim <- local({
              yv <- ceres_f1_df$dependency
              yv <- yv[is.finite(yv)]
              yn <- ceres_f1_df$dependency[ceres_f1_df$is_nepc %in% TRUE]
              yn <- yn[is.finite(yn)]
              if (length(yv) < 2L) {
                pad0 <- 0.14
                if (length(yn) >= 1L) {
                  y_lo0 <- min(min(yn) - pad0, -pad0)
                  y_hi0 <- max(max(yn) + pad0, pad0)
                  return(c(max(-4.8, y_lo0), min(1.2, y_hi0)))
                }
                return(c(-0.35, 0.35))
              }
              qs <- stats::quantile(yv, c(0.04, 0.96), names = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE)
              d <- diff(qs)
              if (!is.finite(d) || d < 0.18) d <- max(0.42, diff(range(yv)))
              pad <- max(0.07, 0.14 * d)
              y_lo <- max(-3.15, qs[[1L]] - pad)
              y_hi <- min(0.62, qs[[2L]] + pad)
              if (length(yn) > 0L) {
                rng_n <- if (length(yn) >= 2L) diff(range(yn)) else 0
                pad_n <- max(0.08, 0.12 * max(rng_n, max(abs(yn), na.rm = TRUE) * 0.12, 0.2))
                y_lo <- min(y_lo, min(yn) - pad_n)
                y_hi <- max(y_hi, max(yn) + pad_n)
                y_lo <- max(-4.6, y_lo)
                y_hi <- min(1.15, y_hi)
              }
              pad0 <- 0.12
              y_lo <- min(y_lo, -pad0)
              y_hi <- max(y_hi, pad0)
              y_lo <- max(-4.85, y_lo)
              y_hi <- min(1.25, y_hi)
              if (!is.finite(y_hi) || y_hi <= y_lo) {
                return(NULL)
              }
              c(y_lo, y_hi)
            })
            .mk_bcl2_ceres_wide <- function(dat, vline_x = NA_real_, labels_fun = .f1_axis_short_met_label) {
              g <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = lab, y = dependency, fill = subtype)) +
                geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA, na.rm = TRUE) +

        crispr_bcl2_f1 <- crispr_bcl2_f1 %>%

          p_bcl2_ceres <- ggplot(crispr_bcl2_f1, aes(x = lineage_group, y = dependency, fill = lineage_group)) +
