            scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#E41A1C", "FALSE" = "gray45"), guide = "none") +
            scale_x_discrete(labels = lab_bcl2_ceres) +
            labs(x = "Lineage", y = "BCL2 CERES") +
            theme_minimal() + .f1_fig12_axis_theme(45) + theme(legend.position = "none")
          vx_fb <- if (exists("f1_vline_x")) f1_vline_x else NA_real_
          if (!is.na(vx_fb) && exists("bcl2_plot_df") && nrow(bcl2_plot_df) > 0L &&
                length(ord_lg) == length(levels(bcl2_plot_df$lab))) {
            p_bcl2_ceres <- p_bcl2_ceres + ggplot2::geom_vline(
              xintercept = vx_fb,
              linetype = "dashed",
              linewidth = f1_rule_line_linewidth,
              alpha = 1,
              colour = f1_rule_line_colour
            )
          }
          bcl2_ceres_plot_df <- dplyr::transmute(
            crispr_bcl2_f1,
            lab = as.character(.data$lineage_group),
            subtype = as.character(.data$lineage_group),
            dependency = .data$dependency
          )
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
.fig12_signif_brackets_wide <- function(p, y_num, ni_p, two_p, vline_x, lv_chr, aml_subtype = "AML (control)", plot_df, ylim = NULL) {
  if (is.null(p)) return(p)
  if (!is.null(ylim) && length(ylim) == 2L && all(is.finite(ylim))) {
    ymin <- ylim[[1L]]
    ymax <- ylim[[2L]]
  } else {
    ymax <- suppressWarnings(max(y_num, na.rm = TRUE))
    ymin <- suppressWarnings(min(y_num, na.rm = TRUE))
  }
  if (!is.finite(ymax) || !is.finite(ymin)) return(p)
  # Anchor brackets to observed y (box tops), not full ylim span — avoids "low" brackets when ylim has headroom (e.g. BCL2 expression cap).
  y_num_f <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(y_num))
  y_num_f <- y_num_f[is.finite(y_num_f)]
  y_dat_max <- if (length(y_num_f)) max(y_num_f) else ymax
  y_dat_min <- if (length(y_num_f)) min(y_num_f) else ymin
  y_dat_max <- min(y_dat_max, ymax)
  y_dat_min <- max(y_dat_min, ymin)
  d_win <- ymax - ymin
  d_dat <- y_dat_max - y_dat_min
  if (!is.finite(d_dat) || d_dat < 1e-6 * d_win) d_dat <- 0.06 * d_win
  tick_h <- max(0.014 * d_win, 0.03 * d_dat)
  lab_dy <- max(0.02 * d_win, 0.028 * d_dat)
  # NI tier just above data; stem-like tier stacked above NI (less total height than two independent offsets from ymax).
  y_hi <- y_dat_max + 0.08 * d_dat + 0.025 * d_win
  gap_tiers <- max(0.035 * d_win, 0.05 * d_dat, tick_h + lab_dy * 0.35)
  y_top <- y_hi + lab_dy + gap_tiers + 0.02 * d_dat
  fmt_p <- function(pv) {
    if (length(pv) != 1L || is.na(pv)) return("—")
    if (pv < 0.001) return("<0.001")
    format.pval(pv, digits = 2)
  }
  sig_sfx <- function(pv) {
    if (length(pv) != 1L || is.na(pv)) return("")
    if (pv < 0.01) return("**")
    if (pv < 0.05) return("*")
    ""
  }
  lv <- lv_chr
  if (length(lv) < 1L) return(p)
  aml_lab_chr <- dplyr::filter(plot_df, as.character(.data$subtype) == aml_subtype) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(.data$lab) %>%
    dplyr::pull(.data$lab) %>%
    as.character()
  aml_lab <- intersect(aml_lab_chr, lv)
  if (length(aml_lab) < 1L) {
    aml_guess <- lv[vapply(lv, function(lb) grepl("^AML\\b", lb), logical(1L))]
    aml_lab <- head(aml_guess, 1L)
  }
  if (length(aml_lab) < 1L) return(p)
  aml_lab <- aml_lab[[1]]
  aml_i <- match(aml_lab, lv)
  if (is.na(aml_i)) return(p)
  # NI-vs-AML bracket should stop strictly left of the red divider (do not include first box to the right, e.g., NSCLC).
  left_i <- if (!is.na(vline_x)) seq_len(max(0L, floor(vline_x))) else integer(0)
  left_i <- setdiff(left_i, aml_i)
  left_i <- left_i[is.finite(left_i) & left_i >= 1L]
  # Top margin: two p-value tiers + large annotate() mm need generous headroom (patchwork row theme must match).
  two_tier <- !is.na(two_p) && !is.na(vline_x) && length(lv_chr) >= 1L
  bracket_plot_margin_top <- as.numeric(if (isTRUE(two_tier)) {
    get0(".f1_fig12_bracket_margin_top_2tier", ifnotfound = 120L, inherits = TRUE)
  } else {
    get0(".f1_fig12_bracket_margin_top_1tier", ifnotfound = 58L, inherits = TRUE)
  })
  # Right margin: keep consistent across all four Fig.1 patchwork panels so column panels align (annotate p-values sit in the right gutter).
  bracket_plot_margin_r <- 36
  if (!is.null(ylim) && length(ylim) == 2L && all(is.finite(ylim))) {
    p2 <- p + ggplot2::coord_cartesian(ylim = ylim, clip = "off") +
      ggplot2::theme(plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(t = bracket_plot_margin_top, r = bracket_plot_margin_r, b = 6, l = 6))
  } else {
    p2 <- p + ggplot2::coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
      ggplot2::theme(plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(t = bracket_plot_margin_top, r = bracket_plot_margin_r, b = 6, l = 6))
  }
  add_bracket_segments <- function(p_in, x0, x1, y0, y1) {
    p_in +
      ggplot2::annotate(
        "segment",
        x = x0, xend = x1, y = y0, yend = y0,
        linewidth = 0.35,
        color = "gray20"
      ) +
      ggplot2::annotate(
        "segment",
        x = x0, xend = x0, y = y0, yend = y1,
        linewidth = 0.35,
        color = "gray20"
      ) +
      ggplot2::annotate(
        "segment",
        x = x1, xend = x1, y = y0, yend = y1,
        linewidth = 0.35,
        color = "gray20"
      )
  }
  xc <- function(i) mean(c(i - 0.25, i + 0.25))
  br_mm <- if (exists(".f1_fig12_bracket_label_mm", inherits = TRUE)) get(".f1_fig12_bracket_label_mm", inherits = TRUE) else 10.5
  if (!is.na(ni_p) && length(left_i) >= 1L) {
    xmin_plastic <- min(left_i)
    p2 <- add_bracket_segments(p2, xmin_plastic, max(left_i), y_hi, y_hi - tick_h)
    p2 <- p2 +
      ggplot2::annotate(
        "text",
        x = mean(c(xc(xmin_plastic), xc(max(left_i)))),
        y = y_hi + lab_dy,
        label = paste0("NI vs AML: ", fmt_p(ni_p), sig_sfx(ni_p)),
        size = br_mm
      )
  }
  if (!is.na(two_p) && !is.na(vline_x)) {
    # Span all lineage boxes (leftmost through rightmost) so the bracket visually covers the full comparator axis.
    xr <- seq_len(length(lv))
    if (length(xr) >= 1L) {
      p2 <- add_bracket_segments(p2, min(xr), max(xr), y_top, y_top - tick_h)
      p2 <- p2 +
        ggplot2::annotate(
          "text",
          x = mean(c(xc(min(xr)), xc(max(xr)))),
          y = y_top + lab_dy,
          label = paste0("Stem-like vs other: ", fmt_p(two_p), sig_sfx(two_p)),
          size = br_mm
        )
    }
  }
  p2
}
# Wide BCL2 expression: bracket p-values (requires fig12_* from `similarity-panels`, which runs before this chunk).
if (!is.null(p_bcl2) && exists("bcl2_plot_df") && is.data.frame(bcl2_plot_df) && nrow(bcl2_plot_df) > 0L && "BCL2" %in% names(bcl2_plot_df)) {
  ni_p_e <- if (exists("fig12_bcl2_ni_p")) fig12_bcl2_ni_p else NA_real_
  two_p_e <- if (exists("fig12_bcl2_two_p")) fig12_bcl2_two_p else NA_real_
  vx_e <- if (exists("f1_vline_x")) f1_vline_x else NA_real_
  lv_e <- as.character(levels(bcl2_plot_df$lab))
  p_bcl2 <- .fig12_signif_brackets_wide(
    p_bcl2,
    y_num = bcl2_plot_df$BCL2,
    ni_p = ni_p_e,
    two_p = two_p_e,
    vline_x = vx_e,
    lv_chr = lv_e,
    plot_df = bcl2_plot_df,
    ylim = if (exists("f1_bcl2_expr_ylim", inherits = TRUE)) f1_bcl2_expr_ylim else NULL
  )
  fig_path_b2 <- if (requireNamespace("here", quietly = TRUE)) here::here("figures", "BCL2_rationale_Fig1.png") else "figures/BCL2_rationale_Fig1.png"
  rmd_fig_b2 <- if (requireNamespace("here", quietly = TRUE)) here::here("rmarkdown", "figures") else file.path("rmarkdown", "figures")
  if (dir.exists(dirname(fig_path_b2))) {
    tryCatch(ggsave(fig_path_b2, p_bcl2, width = 12, height = 6.5, dpi = 150), error = function(e) NULL)
    tryCatch(ggsave(sub("\\.png$", ".pdf", fig_path_b2), p_bcl2, width = 12, height = 6.5, device = "pdf"), error = function(e) NULL)
  }
  if (dir.exists(rmd_fig_b2)) {
    tryCatch(ggsave(file.path(rmd_fig_b2, "BCL2_rationale_Fig1.png"), p_bcl2, width = 12, height = 6.5, dpi = 150), error = function(e) NULL)
    tryCatch(ggsave(file.path(rmd_fig_b2, "BCL2_rationale_Fig1.pdf"), p_bcl2, width = 12, height = 6.5, device = "pdf"), error = function(e) NULL)
  }
  if (exists(".save_expanded_pdf") && ((exists("dnmti_bcl2_expanded_vector_pdf") && isTRUE(dnmti_bcl2_expanded_vector_pdf)) || (exists("hma_bcl2_master_vector_pdf") && isTRUE(hma_bcl2_master_vector_pdf)))) {
    .save_expanded_pdf(p_bcl2, "03_BCL2_rationale_Fig1_wide", 12, 6.5)
  }
}
if (exists("p_bcl2_ceres") && !is.null(p_bcl2_ceres) && exists("bcl2_ceres_plot_df") && is.data.frame(bcl2_ceres_plot_df) && nrow(bcl2_ceres_plot_df) > 0L) {
  ni_p_c <- if (exists("fig12_bcl2_ceres_ni_p")) fig12_bcl2_ceres_ni_p else NA_real_
  two_p_c <- if (exists("fig12_bcl2_ceres_two_p")) fig12_bcl2_ceres_two_p else NA_real_

  p_bcl2_ceres <- .fig12_signif_brackets_wide(

    ni_p = ni_p_c,
    two_p = two_p_c,

    ylim = if (exists("f1_bcl2_ceres_ylim", inherits = TRUE)) f1_bcl2_ceres_ylim else NULL

}
if (exists("p_dnmt1_ceres") && !is.null(p_dnmt1_ceres) && exists("dnmt1_ceres_plot_df") && is.data.frame(dnmt1_ceres_plot_df) && nrow(dnmt1_ceres_plot_df) > 0L &&

    ylim = if (exists("f1_dnmt1_ceres_ylim", inherits = TRUE)) f1_dnmt1_ceres_ylim else NULL
  )
}

# DNMT1 wide panels (same cohort and x-axis as BCL2); rendered with BCL2 in `fig-bcl2-dnmt1-lineage-combined`.

  (exists("expr_meta") && is.data.frame(expr_meta) && "DNMT1" %in% names(expr_meta) && sum(!is.na(expr_meta$DNMT1)) >= 2L)
)
p_dnmt1 <- NULL
if (dnmt1_fig2_ok) {

  # (expr_meta_dnmt1 can be a narrowed subset in some workspaces).
  dnmt1_expr_src <- if (exists("expr_meta") && is.data.frame(expr_meta) && "DNMT1" %in% names(expr_meta)) {

  } else {

  }
  dnmt1_with_lineage <- dnmt1_expr_src %>%

    mutate(
      subtype = as.character(lineage_group),

        lineage_lower == "lung" ~ "Lung",

        as.character(lineage_group) == "AML (control)" ~ "AML",
        grepl("Lymphoma", as.character(.data$lineage_group), fixed = TRUE) |
          as.character(.data$lineage_group) == "DLBCL/MCL/CLL" ~ "Lymphoma",
        grepl("Neuroblastoma", subtype, fixed = TRUE) ~ "Neuroblastoma",
        grepl("TNBC", subtype, fixed = TRUE) ~ "TNBC",
        grepl("Breast", subtype) ~ "Breast",
        grepl("prostate", subtype, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Prostate",
        grepl("Urothelial", subtype, fixed = TRUE) ~ "Urothelial",
        grepl("Renal cell", subtype, fixed = TRUE) ~ "Renal cell",

  dnmt1_lung <- dnmt1_expr_src %>% filter(lineage_lower == "lung", !is.na(DNMT1)) %>%
    inner_join(expr_target %>% filter(lineage_group %in% c("SCLC", "Localized NSCLC", "Metastatic NSCLC")) %>% select(depmap_id, lineage_group), by = "depmap_id") %>%
    mutate(subtype = as.character(lineage_group), tissue = "Lung")

  tissue_order_f2 <- if (exists("f1_tissue_axis_order")) {

  } else {

      "Lung", "ExPulm-SCNEC", "AML", "Neuroblastoma", "Breast",

      "Prostate", "Urothelial", "Renal cell", "Colorectal", "Melanoma", "Sarcoma"
    )
  }
  dnmt1_plot_df_f2 <- dnmt1_plot_df_f2 %>%
    mutate(
      tissue = factor(as.character(tissue), levels = intersect(tissue_order_f2, unique(as.character(tissue)))),
      subtype = factor(
        dplyr::if_else(
          as.character(.data$subtype) %in% c("Localized Neuroblastoma", "Metastatic Neuroblastoma"),
          "Neuroblastoma",
          as.character(.data$subtype)

  dnmt1_keep_f2 <- dplyr::filter(dnmt1_keep_f2, !.f1_exclude_lineage_from_fig12_plots(as.character(.data$subtype)))

  tryCatch({

  dnmt1_plot_df_f2 <- dnmt1_plot_df_f2 %>% left_join(dnmt1_n_lab_f2 %>% select(tissue, subtype, lab), by = c("tissue", "subtype"))
  dnmt1_plot_df_f2 <- dnmt1_plot_df_f2 %>%

      # #region agent log

          data = list(

            pooled_head = utils::head(unique(as.character(pooled_axis_preview2)), 10L)
          )
        )
      }, error = function(e) invisible(NULL))
      # #endregion
      dnmt1_plot_df_f2 <- dnmt1_plot_df_f2 %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          pooled_axis = dplyr::case_when(
            st2 %in% plastic_anchors_f2 ~ st2,
            grepl("Neuroblastoma", st2, fixed = TRUE) & !grepl("^Unspecified", st2, fixed = TRUE) ~ "Neuroblastoma",
            grepl("^Localized\\b", st2) ~ paste0(tt2, " — localized"),
            grepl("^Metastatic\\b", st2) ~ paste0(tt2, " — metastatic"),
            TRUE ~ st2
          )
        ) %>%
        dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data$pooled_axis), nzchar(trimws(as.character(.data$pooled_axis))))
      n_pool2 <- dnmt1_plot_df_f2 %>% dplyr::count(.data$pooled_axis, name = "nn")
      dnmt1_plot_df_f2 <- dnmt1_plot_df_f2 %>%
        dplyr::left_join(n_pool2, by = "pooled_axis") %>%
        dplyr::mutate(lab = paste0(gsub(" \\(control\\)", "", as.character(.data$pooled_axis)), " N=", .data$nn))
      ord2 <- dnmt1_plot_df_f2 %>%
        dplyr::distinct(.data$tissue, .data$pooled_axis, .data$lab) %>%
        dplyr::arrange(.data$tissue, .data$pooled_axis) %>%
        dplyr::pull(.data$lab)
      dnmt1_plot_df_f2 <- dnmt1_plot_df_f2 %>%
        dplyr::mutate(lab = factor(.data$lab, levels = unique(ord2))) %>%
        dplyr::select(-dplyr::any_of(c("pooled_axis", "nn")))
    }
    if (hma_ext_f2 && nrow(dnmt1_plot_df_f2) > 0L) {
      dnmt1_plot_df_f2 <- dnmt1_plot_df_f2 %>%
        dplyr::filter(
          !grepl("Unspecified", as.character(.data$lab), fixed = TRUE) |
            grepl("Unspecified Neuroblastoma", as.character(.data$lab), fixed = TRUE) |
            grepl("Unspecified Sarcoma", as.character(.data$lab), fixed = TRUE)
        )
    }
    dnmt1_plot_df_f2 <- .f1_sanitize_lab_rows(dnmt1_plot_df_f2)
    # Keep TNBC metastatic stratum (mTNBC) for DNMT1 to match BCL2 wide-axis lineage boxes.
    # Match Figure 1 wide x-axis (BCL2 expression) lab order when available
    if (exists("bcl2_plot_df") && is.data.frame(bcl2_plot_df) && "lab" %in% names(bcl2_plot_df)) {
      lev_ref_dn <- levels(bcl2_plot_df$lab)
      if (length(lev_ref_dn) > 0L) {
        # Strictly follow BCL2 wide-axis levels for DNMT1 expression to keep left-column boxes/colors aligned.
        dnmt1_plot_df_f2 <- dnmt1_plot_df_f2 %>%
          dplyr::filter(as.character(.data$lab) %in% lev_ref_dn)
        lev_full_dn <- lev_ref_dn
        dnmt1_plot_df_f2 <- dnmt1_plot_df_f2 %>%
          dplyr::mutate(lab = factor(as.character(.data$lab), levels = lev_full_dn))
      }
    }
    # Bottom-row DNMT1 expression: cap upper y (log2 TPM+1) near ~9 to zoom contrasts.
    f1_dnmt1_expr_y_hi_cap <- 9
    f1_dnmt1_expr_ylim <- local({
      yv <- dnmt1_plot_df_f2$DNMT1
      yv <- yv[is.finite(yv)]
      if (length(yv) < 1L) {
        return(NULL)
      }
      yr <- range(yv)
      d <- diff(yr)
      if (!is.finite(d) || d < 1e-6) d <- 0.45
      pad <- max(0.12, 0.065 * d)
      y_lo <- max(2.5, yr[1] - pad)
      y_hi <- min(f1_dnmt1_expr_y_hi_cap, yr[2] + pad)
      yn <- dnmt1_plot_df_f2$DNMT1[dnmt1_plot_df_f2$is_nepc %in% TRUE]
      yn <- yn[is.finite(yn)]
      if (length(yn) > 0L) {
        rng_n <- if (length(yn) >= 2L) diff(range(yn)) else 0
        pad_n <- max(0.12, 0.12 * max(rng_n, max(abs(yn), na.rm = TRUE) * 0.06, 0.28))
        y_lo <- min(y_lo, min(yn) - pad_n)
        y_hi <- max(y_hi, max(yn) + pad_n)
        y_lo <- max(1.5, y_lo)
        y_hi <- min(12, y_hi)
      }
      if (!is.finite(y_hi) || y_hi <= y_lo) y_hi <- y_lo + 0.55
      c(y_lo, y_hi)
    })
    .mk_dnmt1_expr_plot <- function(dat, vline_x = NA_real_) {
      g <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = lab, y = DNMT1, fill = subtype)) +
        geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) +
        ggplot2::geom_point(
          data = dplyr::filter(dat, .data$is_nepc %in% TRUE),
          ggplot2::aes(x = lab, y = DNMT1),
          inherit.aes = FALSE,
          color = "#E41A1C",
          position = ggplot2::position_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0),
          alpha = 0.92,
          size = 2.5
        ) +
        ggplot2::scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE, labels = .f1_axis_short_met_label) +
        labs(x = "Lineage", y = "DNMT1 expression (log2(TPM+1))") +
        theme_minimal() +
        .f1_fig12_axis_theme(45) +
        theme(legend.position = "none")
      if (!is.na(vline_x)) {
        g <- g + ggplot2::geom_vline(
          xintercept = vline_x,
          linetype = "dashed",
          linewidth = f1_rule_line_linewidth,
          alpha = 1,
          colour = f1_rule_line_colour
        )
      }
      g
    }
    vx_dnmt1_expr <- if (exists("f1_vline_x")) f1_vline_x else NA_real_
    p_dnmt1 <- .mk_dnmt1_expr_plot(dnmt1_plot_df_f2, vline_x = vx_dnmt1_expr)
    if (exists(".fig12_signif_brackets_wide") && exists("bcl2_plot_df") && is.data.frame(bcl2_plot_df) && nrow(dnmt1_plot_df_f2) > 0L) {
      ni_p_d1 <- if (exists("fig12_dnmt1_ni_p")) fig12_dnmt1_ni_p else NA_real_
      two_p_d1 <- if (exists("fig12_dnmt1_two_p")) fig12_dnmt1_two_p else NA_real_
      lv_d1 <- as.character(levels(bcl2_plot_df$lab))
      p_dnmt1 <- .fig12_signif_brackets_wide(
        p_dnmt1,
        y_num = dnmt1_plot_df_f2$DNMT1,
        ni_p = ni_p_d1,
        two_p = two_p_d1,
        vline_x = vx_dnmt1_expr,
        lv_chr = lv_d1,
        plot_df = dnmt1_plot_df_f2,
        ylim = if (exists("f1_dnmt1_expr_ylim", inherits = TRUE)) f1_dnmt1_expr_ylim else NULL
      )
    }
    # DNMT1 expression + CERES are stacked with BCL2 in chunk `fig-bcl2-dnmt1-lineage-combined`.
  }
}
```

```{r fig-bcl2-dnmt1-lineage-combined, cache = FALSE, fig.width = 18, fig.height = 26.5, fig.cap = "Figure 1. BCL2 and DNMT1 expression and genetic dependency across lineages (one composite figure). RNA-seq and CRISPR dependency are from DepMap. Expression is log2(TPM + 1); dependency is CERES (more negative = stronger apparent dependency on the named gene). Layout: 2×2 grid on the same wide lineage x-axis and strata when DNMT1 data are available—top left BCL2 expression, top right BCL2 CERES, bottom left DNMT1 expression, bottom right DNMT1 CERES. Expression panels use the full cohort per `lab`/`subtype`; **wide CERES** panels plot only cell lines with non-missing CERES (same x-axis order and fill colors as BCL2 expression; lines without dependency scores are omitted from the CERES panels). The **N** in each CERES tick label counts plotted dependency scores in that stratum (expression cohort **N** may differ); NEPC-only strata with no plotted CERES have a blank tick label. Lineage tick labels are drawn on **both** bottom-row panels; the top row omits x tick labels. Metastatic strata on the x-axis use an **m** prefix (e.g. mBreast for metastatic breast). Bracketed p-values on the BCL2 panels: pooled non-AML left-of-line arm vs AML (1-sided Wilcoxon; expression stochastic ≥ AML; CERES combined non-AML ≥ AML) and stem-like vs non-stem-like to the right of the dashed rule (expression: stem-like > other). DNMT1 panels use the same comparator logic as in the prior two-figure layout (expression stochastic ≤ AML vs pooled non-AML when that arm applies; CERES combined non-AML ≥ AML; stem-like vs non-stem-like two-group Wilcoxon). On **expression** panels, **points** are drawn for **NEPC** lines only (red); other lines are not overlaid as points. NSCLC strata are non-stem-like comparators for two-group p-values. Abbreviations: AML, acute myeloid leukemia; BCL2, B-cell lymphoma 2; CERES, CRISPR Essentiality Ranked by Expression of effect and Specificity; DepMap, Cancer Dependency Map; DNMT1, DNA methyltransferase 1; ExPulm-SCNEC, extrapulmonary small cell neuroendocrine carcinoma; NEPC, neuroendocrine prostate cancer; NSCLC, non-small cell lung cancer; SCLC, small cell lung cancer; TPM, transcripts per million."}
if (!exists("f1_rule_line_colour")) f1_rule_line_colour <- "#FF2222"
if (!exists("f1_rule_line_linewidth")) f1_rule_line_linewidth <- 1.4
fig_dir_lineage <- if (requireNamespace("here", quietly = TRUE)) here::here("figures") else "figures"
# Canonical wide lineage order and subtype fill = BCL2 expression panel (all four grid panels match these)
lev_f1_grid <- if (exists("bcl2_plot_df") && is.data.frame(bcl2_plot_df) && is.factor(bcl2_plot_df$lab)) {
  levels(bcl2_plot_df$lab)
} else {
  character(0)
}
f1_fill_subtype_levels <- if (exists("bcl2_plot_df") && is.data.frame(bcl2_plot_df) && is.factor(bcl2_plot_df$subtype)) {
  levels(bcl2_plot_df$subtype)
} else if (exists("lineage_levels")) {
  as.character(lineage_levels)
} else {

}
# Per-level colors: golden-ratio hue steps so *consecutive* subtype factor levels are visually far apart
# (sequential hues cluster red/orange/yellow; this mixes cool blues, magentas, greens, etc. along the axis).
.f1_distinct_subtype_palette <- function(level_chr) {
  k <- length(level_chr)
  if (k < 1L) {
    return(character(0))
  }
  if (k == 1L) {
    return(stats::setNames("#5B9BD5", level_chr))
  }
  golden <- 0.6180339887498948482045868343656
  ii <- seq_len(k) - 1L
  h <- (0.11 + ii * golden) %% 1
  s <- 0.70 + 0.24 * ((ii + 1L) %% 3L) / 2
  v <- 0.84 + 0.14 * ((ii + 2L) %% 4L) / 3
  cols <- grDevices::hsv(h = h, s = pmin(0.94, s), v = pmin(0.98, v))
  stats::setNames(cols, level_chr)
}
f1_fill_palette <- if (length(f1_fill_subtype_levels) > 0L) {
  .f1_distinct_subtype_palette(f1_fill_subtype_levels)
} else {
  character(0)
}
.f1_wide_fill_scale <- if (length(f1_fill_palette) > 0L) {
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
    values = f1_fill_palette,
    limits = f1_fill_subtype_levels,
    drop = FALSE,
    na.value = "grey88"
  )
} else {
  NULL
}
.f1_relevel_lab_subtype_df <- function(df) {
  if (is.null(df) || !is.data.frame(df) || length(lev_f1_grid) < 1L) {
    return(df)
  }
  if ("lab" %in% names(df)) {
    df$lab <- factor(as.character(df$lab), levels = lev_f1_grid)
  }
  if ("subtype" %in% names(df) && length(f1_fill_subtype_levels) > 0L) {
    df$subtype <- factor(as.character(df$subtype), levels = f1_fill_subtype_levels)
  }
  df
}
.f1_harmonize_plot_df_to_bcl2 <- function(df) {
  if (is.null(df) || !is.data.frame(df) || !"depmap_id" %in% names(df) || is.null(bcl2_f1_id_map) || nrow(bcl2_f1_id_map) < 1L) {
    return(df)
  }
  drop <- intersect(c("lab", "subtype", "is_nepc"), names(df))
  base <- if (length(drop)) dplyr::select(df, -dplyr::all_of(drop)) else df
  out <- dplyr::inner_join(base, bcl2_f1_id_map, by = "depmap_id")
  .f1_relevel_lab_subtype_df(out)
}
.f1_patch_plot_data <- function(p, df) {
  if (is.null(p) || is.null(df) || !nrow(df)) {
    return(p)
  }
  tryCatch(ggplot2::`%+%`(p, df), error = function(e) p)
}
.theme_f1_hide_lineage_x <- ggplot2::theme(

if (!is.null(.f1_wide_fill_scale)) {

tryCatch({
  b_lv <- if (exists("bcl2_plot_df") && is.data.frame(bcl2_plot_df) && is.factor(bcl2_plot_df$lab)) as.character(levels(bcl2_plot_df$lab)) else character(0)
  d_lv <- if (exists("dnmt1_plot_df_f2") && is.data.frame(dnmt1_plot_df_f2) && is.factor(dnmt1_plot_df_f2$lab)) as.character(levels(dnmt1_plot_df_f2$lab)) else character(0)

  .agent_dbg_ndjson(

      bcl2_levels = b_lv,

      dnmt1_empty_base_levels = d_lv[!nzchar(trimws(sub("\\s*N=\\s*.*$", "", d_lv)))]

  p_r <- if (!is.null(p_bcl2_ceres)) p_bcl2_ceres else patchwork::plot_spacer()
  p_lineage_all <- p_l | p_r
  print(p_lineage_all)

  if (dir.exists(fig_dir_lineage)) {

    tryCatch(
      ggplot2::ggsave(
        file.path(fig_dir_lineage, "Figure1_BCL2_expression_and_dependency.pdf"),
        p_lineage_all,
        width = 18,
        height = h_pdf,
        device = "pdf"
      ),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
  }
  if (exists(".save_expanded_pdf") && ((exists("dnmti_bcl2_expanded_vector_pdf") && isTRUE(dnmti_bcl2_expanded_vector_pdf)) || (exists("hma_bcl2_master_vector_pdf") && isTRUE(hma_bcl2_master_vector_pdf)))) {
    .save_expanded_pdf(p_lineage_all, "03_Figure1_BCL2_DNMT1_lineage_combined", 18, h_pdf)
  }
} else {
  plots_lineage_stack <- list()
  if (!is.null(p_bcl2)) plots_lineage_stack <- c(plots_lineage_stack, list(p_bcl2))
  if (!is.null(p_bcl2_ceres)) plots_lineage_stack <- c(plots_lineage_stack, list(p_bcl2_ceres))
  nl <- length(plots_lineage_stack)
  if (nl > 0L) {
    for (pl in plots_lineage_stack) print(pl)
  } else {
    p_miss <- if (exists("p_placeholder")) {
      p_placeholder
    } else {
      ggplot2::ggplot() +
        ggplot2::theme_void() +
        ggplot2::labs(title = "Insufficient data for lineage expression/CERES figure.")
    }
    print(p_miss)
  }
}
```

```{r ne-lineages-summary-table, cache = FALSE}
# Table 3: per-lineage (all sensitive lineages, same cohort N as two-group) + two-group summaries + Fig. 2b multi-lineage p row
# CRISPR dependency long (cohort lines); N(CERES) can be < expression N
crispr_bcl2_t3 <- NULL
if (exists("crispr") && nrow(crispr) > 0L && exists("target_ids") && length(target_ids) > 0L && exists("expr_target")) {
  crispr_bcl2_t3 <- crispr %>%
    dplyr::filter(grepl("^BCL2\\b", .data$gene_name), .data$depmap_id %in% target_ids) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(expr_target %>% dplyr::select(.data$depmap_id, .data$lineage_group), by = "depmap_id") %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data$lineage_group)) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(.data$depmap_id, .data$lineage_group, BCL2_ceres = .data$dependency)
}
crispr_dnmt1_t3 <- NULL
if (exists("crispr_dnmt1") && nrow(crispr_dnmt1) > 0L && exists("expr_target")) {
  ids_dnmt1 <- if (exists("target_ids") && length(target_ids) > 0L) {
    target_ids
  } else {
    unique(expr_target$depmap_id)
  }
  crispr_dnmt1_t3 <- crispr_dnmt1 %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$depmap_id %in% ids_dnmt1) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data$lineage_group)) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(.data$depmap_id, .data$lineage_group, DNMT1_ceres = .data$dependency)
}
has_dnmt1_tbl <- exists("expr_meta_dnmt1") && is.data.frame(expr_meta_dnmt1) &&
  "DNMT1" %in% names(expr_meta_dnmt1) && nrow(expr_meta_dnmt1) > 0L
has_dnmt1_ceres_tbl <- !is.null(crispr_dnmt1_t3) && nrow(crispr_dnmt1_t3) > 0L
fmt_p_scalar <- function(pv) {
  if (length(pv) != 1L || is.na(pv)) {
    return("—")
  }
  if (pv < 0.001) {
    return("<0.001")
  }
  format.pval(pv, digits = 2)
}
# Multi-lineage BCL2 / DNMT1 CERES p as on Figure 2b corner labels (NI vs AML when computed; else Kruskal)
t3_p_bcl2_ceres_fig2b_multi <- if (exists("bcl2_ceres_ni_p") && !is.na(bcl2_ceres_ni_p)) {
  fmt_p_scalar(bcl2_ceres_ni_p)
} else if (exists("kw_bcl2") && inherits(kw_bcl2, "htest") && length(kw_bcl2$p.value) == 1L && !is.na(kw_bcl2$p.value)) {
  fmt_p_scalar(unname(kw_bcl2$p.value))
} else {
  "—"
}
t3_p_dnmt1_ceres_fig2b_multi <- if (exists("dnmt1_ceres_ni_p") && !is.na(dnmt1_ceres_ni_p)) {
  fmt_p_scalar(dnmt1_ceres_ni_p)
} else if (exists("kw_dnmt1") && inherits(kw_dnmt1, "htest") && length(kw_dnmt1$p.value) == 1L && !is.na(kw_dnmt1$p.value)) {
  fmt_p_scalar(unname(kw_dnmt1$p.value))
} else {
  "—"
}
# Same cohort as two-group summaries (per-lineage N sums to stem-like N)
lineage_plastic_t3 <- if (exists("lineage_plastic_ref_canonical")) lineage_plastic_ref_canonical else c("SCLC", "ExPulm-SCNEC", "AML (control)")
hma_t3_ext <- exists("hma_bcl2_tnbc_lymph_master") && isTRUE(hma_bcl2_tnbc_lymph_master)
t3_use_f1_nb <- exists("f1_enriched_lineages") && length(f1_enriched_lineages) > 0L
if (t3_use_f1_nb) {
  lineage_plastic_t3 <- f1_enriched_lineages
} else if (hma_t3_ext) {
  lineage_plastic_t3 <- unique(c(lineage_plastic_t3, "DLBCL/MCL/CLL"))
}
plastic_lbl_t3 <- "Stem-like"
other_lbl_t3 <- "Non-stem-like"
expr_two_data <- expr_target
if (exists("expr_meta_dnmt1") && "DNMT1" %in% names(expr_meta_dnmt1) && nrow(expr_meta_dnmt1) > 0L) {
  expr_two_data <- expr_two_data %>% dplyr::left_join(expr_meta_dnmt1 %>% dplyr::select(.data$depmap_id, .data$DNMT1), by = "depmap_id")
}
if ("DNMT1" %in% names(expr_two_data)) {
  expr_two_data <- expr_two_data %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data$BCL2) | !is.na(.data$DNMT1))
} else {
  expr_two_data <- expr_two_data %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data$BCL2))
}
if (exists("f1_enriched_lineages_ordered") && length(f1_enriched_lineages_ordered) > 0L) {
  t3_f1_lineages_ordered <- f1_enriched_lineages_ordered[
    as.character(f1_enriched_lineages_ordered) %in% as.character(lineage_plastic_t3)
  ]
} else {
  t3_prio <- c("SCLC", "ExPulm-SCNEC", "AML (control)")
  if (isTRUE(hma_t3_ext)) {
    t3_prio <- c(t3_prio, "DLBCL/MCL/CLL")
  }
  t3_f1_lineages_ordered <- c(
    intersect(t3_prio, as.character(lineage_plastic_t3)),
    setdiff(as.character(lineage_plastic_t3), t3_prio)
  )
}
tbl_ne_summary <- NULL
# Stem-like lineages, per lineage (Figure 1 order; includes SCLC, ExPulm-SCNEC, AML when in arm)
if (length(t3_f1_lineages_ordered) > 0L) {
  t3_f1_dat <- expr_two_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(as.character(.data$lineage_group) %in% as.character(t3_f1_lineages_ordered))
  if (nrow(t3_f1_dat) > 0L) {
      sum_f1 <- t3_f1_dat %>%
        dplyr::group_by(.data$lineage_group) %>%
        dplyr::summarise(
          N = dplyr::n(),
          `BCL2 median` = round(stats::median(.data$BCL2, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
          `BCL2 IQR` = paste0(
            round(stats::quantile(.data$BCL2, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "–",
            round(stats::quantile(.data$BCL2, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), 2)
          ),
          .groups = "drop"
        )
      if (has_dnmt1_tbl && "DNMT1" %in% names(t3_f1_dat) && sum(!is.na(t3_f1_dat$DNMT1)) > 0L) {
        d1f <- t3_f1_dat %>%
          dplyr::group_by(.data$lineage_group) %>%
          dplyr::summarise(
            `DNMT1 median` = round(stats::median(.data$DNMT1, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
            `DNMT1 IQR` = paste0(
              round(stats::quantile(.data$DNMT1, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "–",
              round(stats::quantile(.data$DNMT1, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), 2)
            ),
            .groups = "drop"
          )
        sum_f1 <- sum_f1 %>% dplyr::left_join(d1f, by = "lineage_group")
      }
      sum_f1 <- sum_f1 %>%
        dplyr::mutate(`lg_ord` = match(as.character(.data$lineage_group), as.character(t3_f1_lineages_ordered))) %>%
        dplyr::arrange(.data$`lg_ord`) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(Lineage = gsub(" \\(control\\)", "", as.character(.data$lineage_group))) %>%
        dplyr::select(-.data$lineage_group, -.data$`lg_ord`)
      # CERES per lineage (sensitive arm)
      if (!is.null(crispr_bcl2_t3) && nrow(crispr_bcl2_t3) > 0L) {
        ceres_f1_b <- crispr_bcl2_t3 %>%
          dplyr::filter(as.character(.data$lineage_group) %in% as.character(t3_f1_lineages_ordered)) %>%
          dplyr::group_by(.data$lineage_group) %>%
          dplyr::summarise(
            `BCL2 CERES median` = round(stats::median(.data$BCL2_ceres, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
            `BCL2 CERES IQR` = paste0(
              round(stats::quantile(.data$BCL2_ceres, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "–",
              round(stats::quantile(.data$BCL2_ceres, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), 2)
            ),
            .groups = "drop"
          ) %>%
          dplyr::mutate(Lineage = gsub(" \\(control\\)", "", as.character(.data$lineage_group))) %>%
          dplyr::select(-.data$lineage_group)
        sum_f1 <- sum_f1 %>% dplyr::left_join(ceres_f1_b, by = "Lineage")
      }
      if (!is.null(crispr_dnmt1_t3) && nrow(crispr_dnmt1_t3) > 0L) {
        ceres_f1_d <- crispr_dnmt1_t3 %>%
          dplyr::filter(as.character(.data$lineage_group) %in% as.character(t3_f1_lineages_ordered)) %>%
          dplyr::group_by(.data$lineage_group) %>%
          dplyr::summarise(
            `DNMT1 CERES median` = round(stats::median(.data$DNMT1_ceres, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
            `DNMT1 CERES IQR` = paste0(
              round(stats::quantile(.data$DNMT1_ceres, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "–",
              round(stats::quantile(.data$DNMT1_ceres, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), 2)
            ),
            .groups = "drop"
          ) %>%
          dplyr::mutate(Lineage = gsub(" \\(control\\)", "", as.character(.data$lineage_group))) %>%
          dplyr::select(-.data$lineage_group)
        sum_f1 <- sum_f1 %>% dplyr::left_join(ceres_f1_d, by = "Lineage")
      }
      if (!"BCL2 CERES median" %in% names(sum_f1)) {
        sum_f1 <- sum_f1 %>% dplyr::mutate(`BCL2 CERES median` = NA_real_, `BCL2 CERES IQR` = "")
      }
      if (has_dnmt1_ceres_tbl && !"DNMT1 CERES median" %in% names(sum_f1)) {
        sum_f1 <- sum_f1 %>% dplyr::mutate(`DNMT1 CERES median` = NA_real_, `DNMT1 CERES IQR` = "")
      }
      if (has_dnmt1_tbl && !"DNMT1 median" %in% names(sum_f1)) {
        sum_f1 <- sum_f1 %>% dplyr::mutate(`DNMT1 median` = NA_real_, `DNMT1 IQR` = "")
      }
      sum_f1 <- sum_f1 %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          `p (BCL2)` = "",
          `p (BCL2 CERES)` = "",
          `p (DNMT1)` = if (has_dnmt1_tbl) "" else NA_character_,
          `p (DNMT1 CERES)` = if (has_dnmt1_ceres_tbl) "" else NA_character_
        )
      if (!has_dnmt1_tbl) {
        sum_f1 <- sum_f1 %>% dplyr::mutate(`p (DNMT1)` = NULL)
      }
      if (!has_dnmt1_ceres_tbl) {
        sum_f1 <- sum_f1 %>% dplyr::mutate(`p (DNMT1 CERES)` = NULL)
      }
      hdr_f1 <- tibble::tibble(
        Lineage = "Stem-like lineages (per lineage)",
        N = NA_integer_,
        `BCL2 median` = NA_real_,
        `BCL2 IQR` = "",
        `BCL2 CERES median` = NA_real_,
        `BCL2 CERES IQR` = ""
      )
      if (has_dnmt1_tbl) {
        hdr_f1 <- hdr_f1 %>% tibble::add_column(`DNMT1 median` = NA_real_, `DNMT1 IQR` = "", .after = "BCL2 IQR")
      }
      if (has_dnmt1_ceres_tbl) {
        hdr_f1 <- hdr_f1 %>% tibble::add_column(`DNMT1 CERES median` = NA_real_, `DNMT1 CERES IQR` = "", .after = "BCL2 CERES IQR")
      }
      hdr_f1 <- hdr_f1 %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          `p (BCL2)` = "",
          `p (BCL2 CERES)` = "",

      if (!has_dnmt1_ceres_tbl) {

      n_sensitive_two <- nrow(dplyr::filter(

      tbl_ne_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(tbl_ne_summary, hdr_f1, sum_f1)

}
# Two-group: stem-like vs non-stem-like (expr_two_data already built above)
rows_two_group <- NULL
if (exists("expr_two_data") && nrow(expr_two_data) > 0L) {
  expr_two_data <- expr_two_data %>%
    dplyr::mutate(group_2 = dplyr::if_else(
      as.character(.data$lineage_group) %in% as.character(lineage_plastic_t3),
      plastic_lbl_t3,
      other_lbl_t3
    ))
  rows_two_group <- expr_two_data %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$group_2) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      N = dplyr::n(),
      BCL2_median = round(stats::median(.data$BCL2, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
      BCL2_IQR = paste0(
        round(stats::quantile(.data$BCL2, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "–",
        round(stats::quantile(.data$BCL2, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), 2)
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  if ("DNMT1" %in% names(expr_two_data) && sum(!is.na(expr_two_data$DNMT1)) > 0L) {
    dnmt1_two <- expr_two_data %>%
      dplyr::group_by(.data$group_2) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        DNMT1_median = round(stats::median(.data$DNMT1, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
        DNMT1_IQR = paste0(
          round(stats::quantile(.data$DNMT1, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "–",
          round(stats::quantile(.data$DNMT1, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), 2)
        ),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
    rows_two_group <- rows_two_group %>% dplyr::left_join(dnmt1_two, by = "group_2")
  } else if (has_dnmt1_tbl) {
    rows_two_group <- rows_two_group %>% dplyr::mutate(DNMT1_median = NA_real_, DNMT1_IQR = "")
  }
  # Two-group CERES summaries
  if (!is.null(crispr_bcl2_t3) && nrow(crispr_bcl2_t3) > 0L) {
    ceres_two_b <- crispr_bcl2_t3 %>%
      dplyr::inner_join(expr_two_data %>% dplyr::select(.data$depmap_id, .data$group_2), by = "depmap_id") %>%
      dplyr::group_by(.data$group_2) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        `BCL2 CERES median` = round(stats::median(.data$BCL2_ceres, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
        `BCL2 CERES IQR` = paste0(
          round(stats::quantile(.data$BCL2_ceres, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "–",
          round(stats::quantile(.data$BCL2_ceres, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), 2)
        ),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
    rows_two_group <- rows_two_group %>% dplyr::left_join(ceres_two_b, by = "group_2")
  }
  if (has_dnmt1_ceres_tbl && !is.null(crispr_dnmt1_t3) && nrow(crispr_dnmt1_t3) > 0L) {
    ceres_two_d <- crispr_dnmt1_t3 %>%
      dplyr::inner_join(expr_two_data %>% dplyr::select(.data$depmap_id, .data$group_2), by = "depmap_id") %>%
      dplyr::group_by(.data$group_2) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        `DNMT1 CERES median` = round(stats::median(.data$DNMT1_ceres, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
        `DNMT1 CERES IQR` = paste0(
          round(stats::quantile(.data$DNMT1_ceres, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "–",
          round(stats::quantile(.data$DNMT1_ceres, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), 2)
        ),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
    rows_two_group <- rows_two_group %>% dplyr::left_join(ceres_two_d, by = "group_2")
  }
  if (!"BCL2 CERES median" %in% names(rows_two_group)) {
    rows_two_group <- rows_two_group %>% dplyr::mutate(`BCL2 CERES median` = NA_real_, `BCL2 CERES IQR` = "")
  }
  if (has_dnmt1_ceres_tbl && !"DNMT1 CERES median" %in% names(rows_two_group)) {
    rows_two_group <- rows_two_group %>% dplyr::mutate(`DNMT1 CERES median` = NA_real_, `DNMT1 CERES IQR` = "")
  }
  rows_two_group <- rows_two_group %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Lineage = dplyr::if_else(.data$group_2 == plastic_lbl_t3, "Stem-like", "Non-stem-like"),
      `p (BCL2)` = "",
      `p (BCL2 CERES)` = "",
      `p (DNMT1)` = if (has_dnmt1_tbl) "" else NA_character_,
      `p (DNMT1 CERES)` = if (has_dnmt1_ceres_tbl) "" else NA_character_
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-.data$group_2)
  if (!has_dnmt1_tbl) {
    rows_two_group <- rows_two_group %>% dplyr::mutate(`p (DNMT1)` = NULL)
  }
  if (!has_dnmt1_ceres_tbl) {
    rows_two_group <- rows_two_group %>% dplyr::mutate(`p (DNMT1 CERES)` = NULL)
  }
  rows_two_group <- rows_two_group %>%
    dplyr::rename(`BCL2 median` = .data$BCL2_median, `BCL2 IQR` = .data$BCL2_IQR)
  if (has_dnmt1_tbl) {
    rows_two_group <- rows_two_group %>% dplyr::rename(`DNMT1 median` = .data$DNMT1_median, `DNMT1 IQR` = .data$DNMT1_IQR)
  }
  rows_two_group <- rows_two_group %>%
    dplyr::select(dplyr::any_of(c(
      "Lineage", "N", "BCL2 median", "BCL2 IQR", "DNMT1 median", "DNMT1 IQR",
      "BCL2 CERES median", "BCL2 CERES IQR", "DNMT1 CERES median", "DNMT1 CERES IQR",
      "p (BCL2)", "p (DNMT1)", "p (BCL2 CERES)", "p (DNMT1 CERES)"
    )))
}
t3_p_row_shell <- function(lineage_lbl) {
  pr <- tibble::tibble(
    Lineage = lineage_lbl,
    N = NA_integer_,
    `BCL2 median` = NA_real_,
    `BCL2 IQR` = "",
    `BCL2 CERES median` = NA_real_,
    `BCL2 CERES IQR` = ""
  )
  if (has_dnmt1_tbl) {
    pr <- pr %>% tibble::add_column(`DNMT1 median` = NA_real_, `DNMT1 IQR` = "", .after = "BCL2 IQR")
  }
  if (has_dnmt1_ceres_tbl) {
    pr <- pr %>% tibble::add_column(`DNMT1 CERES median` = NA_real_, `DNMT1 CERES IQR` = "", .after = "BCL2 CERES IQR")
  }
  pr
}
# Multi-lineage subpanels: same p text as BCL2/DNMT1 expression and CERES multi-lineage plots (kw_txt / kw_dnmt1_txt; NI or Kruskal for CERES)
p_row_multi <- t3_p_row_shell("p (Fig. 2b multi-lineage)") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    `p (BCL2)` = if (exists("kw_txt")) kw_txt else "—",
    `p (DNMT1)` = if (has_dnmt1_tbl) (if (exists("kw_dnmt1_txt")) kw_dnmt1_txt else "—") else NA_character_,
    `p (BCL2 CERES)` = t3_p_bcl2_ceres_fig2b_multi,
    `p (DNMT1 CERES)` = if (has_dnmt1_ceres_tbl) t3_p_dnmt1_ceres_fig2b_multi else NA_character_
  )
if (!has_dnmt1_tbl) {
  p_row_multi <- p_row_multi %>% dplyr::mutate(`p (DNMT1)` = NULL)
}
if (!has_dnmt1_ceres_tbl) {
  p_row_multi <- p_row_multi %>% dplyr::mutate(`p (DNMT1 CERES)` = NULL)
}
if (!is.null(rows_two_group) && nrow(rows_two_group) > 0L) {
  tbl_ne_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(tbl_ne_summary, rows_two_group, p_row_multi)
} else {
  tbl_ne_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(tbl_ne_summary, p_row_multi)
}
t3_kable_cols <- c(
  "Lineage", "N", "BCL2 median", "BCL2 IQR", "DNMT1 median", "DNMT1 IQR",
  "BCL2 CERES median", "BCL2 CERES IQR", "DNMT1 CERES median", "DNMT1 CERES IQR",
  "p (BCL2)", "p (DNMT1)", "p (BCL2 CERES)", "p (DNMT1 CERES)"
)
tbl_ne_summary <- tbl_ne_summary %>% dplyr::select(dplyr::any_of(t3_kable_cols))
knitr::kable(tbl_ne_summary, caption = paste0(
  "Table 3. BCL2 and DNMT1 RNA (log2 TPM+1) and CRISPR CERES dependency (median, IQR) in the extended cohort. ",
  "Per-lineage section (when present): each row is one stem-like lineage in Figure 1 order; per-lineage N uses the same expression cohort as the two-group summaries ",
  "(sum of per-lineage N equals N in the stem-like summary row). ",
  "CERES uses DepMap lines with dependency scores (N can be smaller than RNA N). ",
  "Two summary rows compare stem-like vs non-stem-like. ",
  "p (Fig. 2b multi-lineage): same values as the multi-lineage subpanels in Figure 2b—BCL2 and DNMT1 RNA use the annotated expression tests ",
  "(NI vs AML, 1-sided, when shown; else as in figure caption); BCL2 and DNMT1 CERES use the annotated multi-lineage tests ",
  "(NI vs AML, 1-sided, when computed; otherwise Kruskal–Wallis across lineages in that panel)."
))
```

  "**Interpretation (Figure 2b subfigures in Figures 1 and 2)**: **BCL2:** Multi-lineage subpanel reports **non-inferior vs AML** (1-sided Wilcoxon, BCL2 stochastically ≥ AML; p = ", kw_s, "); two-group subpanel compares stem-like vs non-stem-like (**1-sided** Wilcoxon, stem-like > non-stem-like; p = ", wx_s, "). **DNMT1:** When the Fig. 1 arm applies, multi-lineage subpanel reports **non-inferior vs AML** (1-sided Wilcoxon, DNMT1 stochastically ≤ AML; p = ", kwd_s, "); otherwise Kruskal–Wallis across lineages (same p text). ))
